ह: ह The thirty-third and last consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet; the letter H.

ह Subst. mfn. (हः-हा-हं) Laughter. Adj. Mad, drunk. m. (-हः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 Water. 3 A cypher. 4 Meditation. 5 Auspiciousness. 6 Sky, heaven. 7 Paradise. 8 Blood. 9 Dying. 10 Fear. 11 Knowledge. 12 The moon. 13 VIṢṆU. 14 War, battle. 15 Horripilation. 16 A horse. 17 Pride. 18 A physician. 19 Cause, motive. f. (हा) 1 Abandoning, leaving. 2 Coition. 3 A lute. n. (-हं) GOD, the supreme soul. 2 Pleasure, delight. 3 Calling, calling to. 4 A weapon. 5 The sparkling of a gem 6 The sound of a lute. ind. 1 An expletive. 2 A vocative particle (ho! holla!) 2 A term of rejection or disdain. 4 A particle of abuse or reproach: see हा, ही, &c. E. हा to abandon, or हन to strike, &c., aff. क or ड.
हंस: हंस m. (-सः) 1 A goose, a gander, a swan. 2 BRAHMA, the supreme soul. 3 VIṢṆU. 4 The sun. 5 A liberal or moderate prince, one not covetous nor ambitious. 6 A sort of ascetic or devotee. 7 A particular Mantra, or mystical or magical prayer. 8 A horse. 9 One of the vital airs. 10 Envy, malice. 11 ŚIVA. 12 (In composition,) Best, excellent. 13 Preceding, before, in front. 14 A spiritual preceptor. 15 A mountain. 16 A buffalo. 17 KĀMA. f. (-सी) A goose. E. हन् to hurt or kill, Uṇādi aff. स.
हंसक: हंसक m. (-कः) 1 An ornament for the feet, described as being made like a goose's foot. 2 The flamingo. E. कन् added to the last.
हंसकूट: हंसकूट m. (-टः) The hump on the shoulder of the Indian ox. E. हंस a goose, and कूट a peak.
हंसगद्गदा: हंसगद्गदा f. (-दा) A woman speaking sweetly or pleasantly. E. हंस a goose, गद to sound, reiterated, aff. अच् and टाप्.
हंसगामिनी: हंसगामिनी f. (-नी) A graceful woman. E. हंस a goose, (or swan,) and गामिनी who goes, (like.)
हंसदाहन: हंसदाहन n. (-नं) Agallochum. E. हंस a goose, and दाहन burning, exciting.
हंसनाद: हंसनाद m. (-दः) Cackling, the cry or noise of a goose. E. हंस, and नाद sound.
हंसनादिन्: हंसनादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Cackling, making a noise like a goose. f. (-नी) An elegant woman, one of slender waist and large posteriors, with the gait of an elephant and voice of a Koïl. E. हंस a goose, नाद cry, इनि and ङीष् affs.
हंसपदी: हंसपदी f. (-दी) 1 A scandent shrub, (Cissus pedata.) 2 Another plant, perhaps Clitoria ternata. E. हंस a goose, and पद foot; from a fancied resemblance between it and the flower; also हंसपादी.
हंसपाद: हंसपाद n. (-दं) Vermilion. f. (-दी) A shrub, (Clitoria ternata?) E. हंस a goose, पाद a foot, (to which they are compared in colour, form, &c.:) see the last; also in the fem. form, कन् added, हंसपादिका.
हंसमाला: हंसमाला f. (-ला) 1 A duck. 2 A flight or flock of wild geese. E. हंस a goose, माला a garland or wreath.
हंसरथ: हंसरथ m. (-थः) BRAHMĀ. E. हंस a goose, and रथ vehicle.
हंसवती: हंसवती f. (-ती) A creeper, (Cissus pedata.) E. हंस a goose, (its foot,) and मतुप् aff.
हंसवाहन: हंसवाहन m. (-नः) BRAHMĀ. E. हंस a goose, and वाहन A vehicle.
हंसाङ्घ्रि: हंसाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) Vermilion. E. हंस a goose, and अङ्घ्रि the foot.
हंसाभिख्य: हंसाभिख्य n. (-ख्यं) Silver. E. हंस a goose, अभिख्या beauty; being of similar colour.
हंसिका: हंसिका f. (-का) A goose. E. हंसी the same, and कन् added, or हन to kill, सिकन् Uṇādi aff.
हंहो: हंहो ind. 1 An interjection of calling, (ho, holla!). 2 A particle of haughtiness or arrogance. 3 An arrogantly interrogative particle. E. हं and हो, both vocative particles.
हक्क: हक्क m. (-क्कः) The call of elephants. E. हक् imitative sound, कै to utter, ड aff.
हक्कार: हक्कार m. (-रः) Calling, calling to. E. हक् sound of calling, and कार making.
हञ्जा: हञ्जा ind. (In theatrical language.) A vocative particle used in calling to a female attendant. E. हिडि to treat with disrespect or contempt, aff. आ, and the deriv. irr.; also with ए, aff. हञ्जे.
हञ्जे: हञ्जे ind. (In theatrical language,) a vocative particle to be used in addressing a female attendant. E. see हञ्जा.
हट्ट: हट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A market, a moveable market, a fair. f. (-ट्टी) A petty market or fair. E. हट to shine, ट aff., form irr.
हट्टचौरक: हट्टचौरक m. (-कः) A thief, one stealing at fairs and markets. E. हट्ट a market, and चौर a thief, कन् pleonasm.
हट्टविलासिनी: हट्टविलासिनी f. (-नी) 1 A sort of drug and perfume. 2 A whore. E. हट्ट a market, विलस to wanton or delight, णिनि and ङीप् aff.
हठ: हठ r. 1st cl. (हठति) 1 To leap or jump. 2 To be wicked. 3 To treat with violence, to oppress. 4 To bind to a post.
हठ m. (-ठः) 1 Violence. 2 Oppression. 3 Rapine. mf. (-ठः-ठी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. हठ to treat with violence, aff. अच्.
हठपर्णी: हठपर्णी f. (-र्णी) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. हठ Pistia, and पर्ण a leaf.
हठालु: हठालु m. (-लुः) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. हठ the same, and आलु a root.
हडि: हडि m. (-डिः) A sort of stocks or wooden fetters.
हडिक: हडिक m. (-कः) A sweeper, a servant of the lowest caste and meanest function.
हड्डक: हड्डक m. (-कः) A sweeper, a Mehter.
हड्डज: हड्डज n. (-जं) The marrow of the bones. E. हड्ड a bone, and ज born.
हण्डा: हण्डा ind. An interjection of calling to a low female: see हण्डे.
हण्डिका: हण्डिका f. (-का) An earthen pot or boiler; also हण्डी.
हण्डिकासुत: हण्डिकासुत m. (-तः) A small earthen pot. E. हण्डिका an earthen pot, and सुत son.
हण्डे: हण्डे ind. A vocative particle to be addressed in theatrical language to a female of inferior rank. E. हिडि to treat with contempt or disrespect, aff. ए, and the form irr.; also with आ, aff. हण्डा.
हत: हत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck, hurt, killed. 2 Destroyed. 3 Departed, lost. 4 Ended. 5 Deprived of, devoid of. 6 Disappointed. 7 Multiplied, (in arithmetic.) n. (-तं) 1 Multiplication. 2 Hurting, killing. E. हन् to strike or hurt, aff. क्त.
हतक: हतक m. (-कः) A coward, a poltroon. E. हत slain, कन् aff.
हतचित: हतचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bewildered, astounded, bereft of sense. E. हत, and चित mind.
हतजीवित: हतजीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Deprived of life or hope, overcome with despair. n. (-तं) Despair. E. हत, and जीवित living.
हतताप: हतताप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Cool after great heat. E. हत, and ताप heat.
हतसम्पद: हतसम्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Reduced to poverty. E. हत, and सम्पद property.
हतसाध्वस: हतसाध्वस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Fearless, free from fear. E. हत, and साध्वस fear.
हताश: हताश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Cruel, merciless. 2 Desponding, despairing. 3 Vile, wicked. 4 Barren. 5 Weak, powerless. E. हत destroyed, and आशा hope, (in or by whom.)
हताश्व: हताश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) Having the horses killed. E. हत, and अश्व a horse.
हतौजस्: हतौजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Debilitated, weak. m. (-जाः) A kind of fever, fever with debility. E. हत, and ओजस् vigour.
हत्नु: हत्नु m. (-त्नुः) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 A weapon. E. हन् to kill or hurt, कत्नुच् Uṇādi aff.
हत्या: हत्या f. (-त्या) Killing, slaying, (used chiefly in composition, as ब्रह्महत्या the murder of a Brahman, रिपुहत्या killing an enemy.) E. हन् to kill, क्यप् aff., and न changed to त.
हत्वा: हत्वा ind. Having struck or killed. E. हन to hurt, &c., क्त्वा aff.
हथ: हथ m. (-थः) A man dejected or in low spirits. E. हन् to hurt, क्थन् aff.
हद: हद r. 1st cl. (हदते) To evacuate as fæces.
हन: हन r. 2nd cl. (हन्ति pl. घ्नन्ति) 1 To hurt, to strike, to injure, to do any act which tends to the destruction of life, to kill. 2 To go, to move. 3 To put an end to in any manner. With अभि, To sound a musical instrument. With आङ्, To smite. With नि or परि, To destroy, entirely. With प्र, 1 To strike. 2 To place upon. With प्रति, To refute or destroy, an opposite argument. With वि and आङ्, To obstruct, to prevent, to hinder. With सम्, To slaughter: (घन् or ध्न is substituted for the radical letters of this verb in many of its inflections and derivatives; the root also takes most of the prefixes with little or no variation of the sense.)
हन m. (-नः) A killer, a slayer. E. हन to kill, अच् aff.; also with क्विप्, aff. हन् m. (-हा).
हनन: हनन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, destroying. 2 Injuring, hurting, striking. 3 (In arithmetic,) Multiplication. E. हन् to hurt or kill, aff. ल्युट्.
हननीय: हननीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) What may be or ought to be struck, beaten, killed. E. हन to kill, अनीयर् aff.
हनु: हनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः or नूः) The jaw. f. (-नुः) 1 A drug and perfume: see हट्टविलासिनी. 2 A weapon. 3 Sickness. 4 Death, dying E. हन् to hurt or kill, aff. उ.
हनुग्रह: हनुग्रह m. (-हः) Locked jaw. E. हनु, and ग्रह seizure.
हनुमत्: हनुमत् m. (-मान्) 1 The monkey chief HANUMĀN, the son of AÑJANĪ, by PAVANA, or the wind, the friend, ally and spy of RĀMACANDRA, in his invasion of Laṅkā. 2 A particular sort of monkey, (Simia sinica.) E. हनु the jaw, and मतुप् aff.; also with हनू the same, हनूमत् m. (-मान्.)
हनुस्तम्भ: हनुस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) Locked jaw. E. हनु, and स्तम्भ stiffness.
हनूष: हनूष m. (-षः) A goblin, a demon. E. हन to kill, ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.
हन्त: हन्त ind. 1 An inceptive particle. 2 An exclamation of grief, (ah, alas!) 3 Of pity. 4 Of pleasure. 5 Of hurry or haste. E. हन् to kill, त aff.
हन्तव्य: हन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What may be, or ought to be struck, killed, &c. E. हन, and तव्य aff.
हन्ताकार: हन्ताकार m. (-रः) Rice to be given to a guest. E. हन्ता a measure of food, and कार making.
हन्तु: हन्तु m. (-न्तुः) 1 Death. 2 A bull. E. हन to kill, तु aff.
हन्तृ: हन्तृ m. (-न्ता) 1 A murderer, a slayer. 2 A measure of food, four times four double handfuls. E. हन to kill, तृच् Uṇādi aff.
हन्तोक्ति: हन्तोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Tenderness, compassion. E. हन्त alas! and उक्ति saying.
हन्न: हन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Passed as ordure. E. हद to void fæces, aff. क्त.
हन्यमान: हन्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being killed or struck. E. हन to hurt or kill, pass. v., शानच् aff.
हम्: हम् ind. 1 An interjection of wrath. 2 An expression of courtesy or respect.
हम्भा: हम्भा f. (-म्भा) The lowing of kine. E. हम् imitative sound, भा to shine, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
हम्भारवविराविन्: हम्भारवविराविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Lowing, bellowing. E. हम्भा, रव sound, विराविन् uttering.
हम्म: हम्म r. 1st cl. (हम्मति) To go, to move.
हय: हय r. 1st cl. (हयति) 1 To move. 2 To worship. 3 To sound. 4 To be weary.

हय m. (-यः) 1 A horse. 2 A man of a particular class. 3 The number seven. 4 INDRA. 5 The Yak. 6 (In prosody,) A foot of four short syllables, a proceleusmaticus. f. (-यी) A mare. E. हय to go, or हि to go, aff. अच्.
हयगन्धा: हयगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. हय a horse, and गन्ध smell.
हयग्रीव: हयग्रीव m. (-वः) A prince of the Daityas, who during BRAHMĀ'S sleep at the end of a Kalpa stole the Vedas; in the recovery of them, he was slain by VIṢṆU, after his descent as the Matsya or fish Avatāra. E. हय a horse, and ग्रीबा neck.
हयग्रीवहन्: हयग्रीवहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. हयग्रीव the Daitya, and हन् slayer.
हयङ्कष: हयङ्कष m. (-षः) 1 A driver, a charioteer. 2 INDRA'S charioteer. E. हय a horse, and कष to hurt, aff. खच्.
हयज्ञ: हयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A horse-dealer, a groom, one who is a judge of the qualities of a horse. E. हय, and ज्ञ who knows.
हयज्ञता: हयज्ञता f. (-ता) Horsemanship, knowledge of horses and their management. E. तल् added to the last.
हयद्विषत्: हयद्विषत् m. (-न्) The buffalo. E. हय, and द्विषत् foe.
हयन: हयन n. (-नं) A covered carriage. m. (-नः) A year. E. हय to go, ल्युट् aff.
हयपुच्छ: हयपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A horse's tail. f. (-च्छी) A leguminous plant, (Glycine debilis.) E. हय a horse, and पुच्छ the tail.
हयप्रिय: हयप्रिय m. (-यः) Barley. E. हय a horse, and प्रिय fond of.
हयमारक: हयमारक m. (-कः) A shrub, (Nerium odorum.) E. हय a horse, and मारक killer; also with मार the same, हयमार m. (-रः.)
हयमारण: हयमारण m. (-णः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. हय a horse, and मारण killing.
हयमेध: हयमेध m. (-धः) The sacrifice of a horse: see अश्वमेघ. E. हय, and मेध sacrifice.
हयवाहन: हयवाहन m. (-नः) 1 The son of SŪRYA or the sun. 2 KUVERA. E. हय a horse, and वाहन a vehicle.
हयवाहनसङ्कर: हयवाहनसङ्कर m. (-रः) Mountain ebony, the red sort.
हयानन्द: हयानन्द m. (-न्दः) Kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. हय a horse, and आनन्द delighting.
हयारि: हयारि m. (-रिः) A shrub, (Nerium odorum.) E. हय a horse, and अरि inimical.
हयारूढ: हयारूढ m. (-ठः) A horseman, a rider. E. हय, and आरूढ mounted on.
हयारोह: हयारोह m. (-हः) Riding, horsemanship. E. हय, and आरीह mounting.
हयाशना: हयाशना f. (-ना) The gum Olibanum tree. E. हय a horse, and अशन food.
हयोत्तम: हयोत्तम m. (-मः) An excellent horse. E. हय a horse, and उत्तम best.
हर: हर mfn. (-रः-री or रा-रं) Who or what takes or seizes, carries or conveys, &c. m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 AGNI. 3 An ass. 4 (In arithmetic,) A divisor; also the denominator of a fraction. E. हृ to take, aff. अप् or टच्.
हरक: हरक m. (-कः) 1 A rogue, a cheat. 2 A person of reflection. 3 A taker, a conveyer, a seizer. 4 (In arithmetic,) A divisor; also division. 5 ŚIVA. E. हृ to take, वुन् aff.
हरचूडामणि: हरचूडामणि m. (-णिः) The moon. E. हर ŚIVA, चूडा the crest, and मणि a gem.
हरण: हरण n. (-णं) Taking, (either in a good or bad sense,) accepting, receiving, seizing, carrying off or away. 2 A special gift, as a nuptial present, alms to a student at his initiation, &c. 3 The arm. 4 Semen virile. 5 Gold. 6 A Kowri. 7 Boiling water. 8 (In arithmetic,) Dividing, division. m. (-णः) The hand. E. हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.
हरणीय: हरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taken, seized, accepted, &c. E. हृ to take, अनीयर् aff.
हरत्: हरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत) Taking, seizing. E. हृ to take, शतृ aff.
हरवीज: हरवीज n. (-जं) Quicksilver. E. हर ŚIVA, and वीज semen.
हरशेखरा: हरशेखरा f. (-रा) The Ganges. E. हर ŚIVA, and शेखरा crest.
हरहूरा: हरहूरा f. (-रा) A grape; also हारहूरा.
हराद्रि: हराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) Mount Kailāsa, the favourite resort of ŚIVA. E. हर ŚIVA, and अद्रि mountain.
हरि: हरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) 1 Green. 2 Tawny. 3 Yellow. m. (-रिः) 1 VIṢṆU, or as considered to be the same deity, KṚṢṆA. 2 YAMA. 3 Air, wind. 4 INDRA. 5 The moon. 6 The sun. 7 A lion. 8 A ray of light. 9 A horse. 10 A parrot. 11 An ape. 12 A snake. 13 A frog. 14 ŚIVA. 15 One of the nine Varṣas into which the known continent is divided. 16 BRAHMĀ. 17 Fire. 18 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 19 A goose. 20 A peacock. 21 Green, (the colour.) 22 Tawny, the colour. 23 A golden colour, or yellow. E. हृ to take, to seize, (the world or men's hearts, &c.,) Uṇādi aff. इ.
हरिक: हरिक m. (-कः) 1 A horse of a yellowish blue tint. 2 A thief. 3 A gambler. E. कन् added to the last.
हरिकेलीय: हरिकेलीय m. (-यः) Bengal. E. हरि VIṢṆU, केलि sport, and छ aff.
हरिकेश: हरिकेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, क BRAHMĀ, and ईश lord.
हरिगृह: हरिगृह n. (-हं) A city and district, also Sambhalpur. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and गृह abode.
हरिचन्दन: हरिचन्दन mn. (-नः-नं) 1 A yellow and fragrant sort of Sandal wood. 2 One of the trees of paradise. n. (-नं) 1 Saffron. 2 Moon-light. 3 The farina of the lotus. 4 The person of a lover or mistress. E. हरि VIṢṆU, or yellow, and चन्दन Sandal.
हरिण: हरिण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Yellowish white. m. (-णः) 1 A deer. 2 Yellowish white, (the colour.) 3 White. 4 VIṢṆU. 5 ŚIVA. 6 The sun. 7 A goose. 8 A minor division of the world. f. (-णी) 1 A doe. 2 A golden image. 3 A woman, one of the four kinds, the same as the Citriṇī, or female of the man termed Mṛga. 4 A form of metre, a variety of the class termed Atyaṣṭi or verse of four lines of 17 syllables each. 5 Green: see हरित. 6 Yellow jasmine. E. हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. इनच्.
हरिणकलङ्क: हरिणकलङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The moon. E. हरिण a deer, कलङ्क a spot.
हरिणनयन: हरिणनयन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Deer-eyed. E. हरिण, and नयन the eye; also हरिण, लोचन, हरिणाक्षि, &c.
हरिणनर्तक: हरिणनर्त्तक m. (-कः) A chorister of INDRA'S heaven. E. हरिण a deer, and नर्त्तक a dancer.
हरिणनर्त्तक: हरिणनर्त्तक m. (-कः) A chorister of INDRA'S heaven. E. हरिण a deer, and नर्त्तक a dancer.
हरिणप्लुता: हरिणप्लुता f. (-ता) A stanza having eleven syllables in every first and third Pāda, and twelve in every second and fourth.
हरिणहृदय: हरिणहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fearful, timid. E. हरिण a deer, and हृदय heart; deer-hearted.
हरिणाक्षी: हरिणाक्षी f. (-क्षी) 1 A perfume, commonly Hāttavilāsinī. 2 A woman with handsome eyes. E. हरिण a deer, and अक्षि the eye, fem. aff. ङीष.
हरिणाङ्क: हरिणाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The moon. E. हरिण a deer, and अङ्क mark or symbol.
हरित्: हरित् mfn. (-रित्) Green, of a green colour. m. (-त्) 1 Green, (the colour.) 2 A swift horse or a horse of the sun. 3 Kidneybean, (Phaseolus mungo.) 4 A lion. 5 The sun. 6 VIṢṆU. mn. (-रित्) Grass. f. (-रित्). 1 A quarter or region, a point of the compass. 2 Turmeric. E. हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. इति.
हरित: हरित mfn. (-तः-ता or रिणी-तं) 1 Green, of a green colour. 2 Grassy, verdant. m. (-तः) 1 Green, (the colour.) 2 A lion. f. (-ता) 1 Bent grass. 2 Turmeric. 3 A brown or tawny grape. E. हृ to take, इतन् Uṇādi aff.
हरितक: हरितक n. (-कः) A potherb. E. हरित green, and कन् added.
हरितच्छद: हरितछद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Green-leaved. E. हरित, and छद a leaf.
हरितछद: हरितछद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Green-leaved. E. हरित, and छद a leaf.
हरितायत्: हरितायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Becoming green. E. हरित used as a verb, शतृ aff.
हरिताल: हरिताल n. (-लं) Yellow orpiment. f. (-ली) 1 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) 2 A streak or line in the sky, (the milky way?) 3 A sort of creeper. E. हरित green, अल to possess or adorn, aff. अण्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
हरितालक: हरितालक m. (-कः) The green pigeon. n. (-कं) Theatrical decoration, painting the person, &c. E. हरिताल orpiment, कन् aff.
हरितालिका: हरितालिका f. (-का) 1 A sort of grass, (Panicum dactylon, Rox.) 2 The fourth lunar day of the month Bhadra. E. कन् added to हरिताल, fem. form.
हरिताश्मन्: हरिताश्मन् n. (-श्म) 1 Blue vitriol. 2 A turquoise. 3 An emerald. E. हरित green, अश्मन् a stone.
हरितीकृत: हरितीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made verdant or green, coloured green, &c. E. हरित, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
हरित्पर्ण: हरित्पर्ण n. (-र्णं) A radish. E. हरित् green, and पर्ण a leaf.
हरिदश्व: हरिदश्व m. (-श्वः) The sun. E. हरित् green, and अश्व a horse.
हरिदेव: हरिदेव m. (-वः) The asterism Srāvaṇa. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and देव presiding deity.
हरिद्रव: हरिद्रव m. (-वः) A powder of the blossoms of the Mesua ferrea.
हरिद्रा: हरिद्रा f. (-द्रा) Turmeric, (either the plant or the powdered root.) E. हरित् green, द्रु to flow or ooze, aff. ड, or हरि VIṢṆU, &c., दृ to be regarded, aff. क.
हरिद्राक्त: हरिद्राक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Smeared or stained with turmeric. E. हरिद्रा, and अक्त anointed.
हरिद्राङ्ग: हरिद्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A yellow bird. E. हरिद्रा turmeric, and अङ्ग body.
हरिद्राभ: हरिद्राभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Of a yellow colour. m. (-भः) 1 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) 2 Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) 3 Yellow, the colour. E. हरिद्रा turmeric, आभ resembling.
हरिद्राराग: हरिद्राराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Fickle, capricious, unsteady, in affection or attachment. E. हरिद्रा turmeric, and राग colour, in opposition to the नीलराग or true blue; also with कन् added. हरिद्रारागक.
हरिद्रु: हरिद्रु m. (-द्रुः) 1 A tree. 2 A plant, (Curcuma zanthorrhizon.) E. हरि a monkey, द्रु to go, Uṇādi aff. कु.
हरिद्वार: हरिद्वार n. (-रं) The town of Haridvār, where the Ganges descends into the level land of Hindustan. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and द्वार gate; being the road to Vaikuṇṭha or VIṢṆU'S heaven.
हरिनामन्: हरिनामन् m. (-मा) A kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. हरि the same, and नामन् appellation.
हरिनेत्र: हरिनेत्र m. (-त्रः) An owl. n. (-त्रं) The white lotus. E. हरि VIṢṆU, &c., and नेत्र an eye.
हरिन्मणि: हरिन्मणि m. (-णिः) An emerald. E. हरित् green, and मणि a gem.
हरिपर्ण: हरिपर्ण n. (-र्णं) A radish. E. हरि green, and पर्ण a leaf; also हरित्पर्ण.
हरिप्रिय: हरिप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Liked or loved by VIṢṆU, &c. m. (-यः) 1 A tree, (Nauclea Cadamba.) 2 ŚIVA. 3 A fool, a blockhead. 4 Armour, mail. n. (-यं) 1 A dark sort of Sandal wood. 2 The fragrant root of the Andropogon muricatum. f. (-या) 1 LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU. 2 Tulasi or basil. 3 The twelfth day of the lunar fortnight. 4 The earth. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and प्रिय beloved.
हरिबालुक: हरिबालुक n. (-कं) A perfume and drug, commonly Elavāluka. E. हरि tawny, बालुका sand.
हरिभद्र: हरिभद्र n. (-द्रं) A sort of perfume, commonly Elavāluka.
हरिभुज्: हरिभुज् m. (-भुक्) A snake. E. हरि a frog, and भुज् what eats.
हरिमन्: हरिमन् m. (-मा) Time. E. हृ to take, इमनिच् Uṇādi aff.
हरिमन्थ: हरिमन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 A tree, (Premna longifolia.) 2 Chick pea. E. हरि fire or a horse, &c., and मन्थ agitating or churning.
हरिमन्थक: हरिमन्थक m. (-कः) Chick pea, (Cicer arietinum.) E. कन् added to the last.
हरिमन्थज: हरिमन्थज m. (-जः) 1 Chick pea. 2 A sort of kidney-bean. E. हरि a horse, &c., मन्थ churning, chewing, जन to produce, aff. ड.
हरिय: हरिय m. (-यः) A horse of a yellow colour.
हरिले: हरिले ind. A term of calling in theatrical language, addressed to a female slave.
हरिलोचन: हरिलोचन m. (-नः) 1 A crab. 2 An owl. E. हरि green, and लोचन the eye.
हरिवत्: हरिवत् m. (-वान्) INDRA. E. हरि a horse, and मतुप् aff.
हरिवर्ष: हरिवर्ष n. (-र्षं) A division of the old or known continent; the country between the Niṣadha and Hemakūṭa mountains. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and वर्ष a division of the world.
हरिवाहन: हरिवाहन m. (-नः) GARUḌA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and वाहन a vehicle.
हरिवीज: हरिवीज n. (-जं) Yellow orpiment. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and वीज semen.
हरिवृष: हरिवृष n. (-षं) A division of the continent: see हरिवर्ष.
हरिशर: हरिशर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and शर an arrow; VIṢṆU having served him as the shaft which set the cities of TRIPURA on fire.
हरिश्चन्द्र: हरिश्चन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A sovereign, the twenty-eighth of the solar dynasty in the second age, celebrated for his piety and liberality, and who on those accounts was elevated, together with his subjects, to heaven: having been insidiously induced by NĀRADA, to relate his actions with unbecoming pride, he descended from Svarga, a stage at each sentence, till stopping in time, and doing homage to the gods, he was fixed with his capital in mid-air. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and चन्द्र the moon.
हरिश्चन्द्रपुर: हरिश्चन्द्रपुर n. (-रं) The city of HARIŚCANDRA: see the last. E. हरिश्चन्द्र a name, and पुर city.
हरिषेण: हरिषेण m. (-णः) The tenth of the twelve universal emperors enumerated by the Jainas. E. हरि VIṢṆU, &c., and सेना a host.
हरिसुत: हरिसुत m. (-तः) One of the emperors of the Jainas; also named HARIṢEṆA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and सुत the son.
हरिहय: हरिहय m. (-यः) 1 INDRA. 2 The sun. 3 SKANDA. 4 GAṆEŚA. E. हरि green, and हय a horse.
हरिहरात्मक: हरिहरात्मक m. (-कः) 1 GARUḌA. 2 DAKṢA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and हर ŚIVA, आत्मन् self, same, कन् added.
हरीतकी: हरीतकी f. (-की) Yellow or Chebulic myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula:) seven varieties of this are distinguished. E. हरि green, (colour,) इत gone, got, कन् added, fem. aff. ङीष्.
हरेणु: हरेणु f. (-णुः) 1 A drug and perfume, commonly Reṇukā. 2 A reputable woman. 3 Pulse, peas. 4 A deer of a copper colour. m. (-णुः) 1 Laṅkā. 2 A creeper, marking the boundary of a village. E. हृ to take, एणु Uṇādi aff.
हर्तव्य: हर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be seized, taken, accepted, &c. E. हृ to take, तव्यर् aff.
हर्त्तव्य: हर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be seized, taken, accepted, &c. E. हृ to take, तव्यर् aff.
हर्तृ: हर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Taking, seizing, conveying, who takes or receives. E. हृ to take or convey, aff. तृच्.
हर्त्तृ: हर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Taking, seizing, conveying, who takes or receives. E. हृ to take or convey, aff. तृच्.
हर्मन्: हर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Gaping, yawning. E. हृ to take, मनिन् aff.
हर्म्मन्: हर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Gaping, yawning. E. हृ to take, मनिन् aff.
हर्मित: हर्म्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thrown, cast, sent. 2 Burnt.
हर्म्मित: हर्म्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thrown, cast, sent. 2 Burnt.
हर्मुट: हर्म्मुट m. (-टः) 1 The sun. 2 A tortoise.
हर्म्मुट: हर्म्मुट m. (-टः) 1 The sun. 2 A tortoise.
हर्म्म्य: हर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्म्यं) A palace, a mansion, the habitation of a man of wealth or rank. E. हृ to take, (the mind,) यत् aff., and मुट् augment.
हर्य: हर्य्य r. 1st cl. (हर्य्यति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To desire. 3 To be weary.
हर्य्य: हर्य्य r. 1st cl. (हर्य्यति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To desire. 3 To be weary.
हर्यक्ष: हर्य्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A lion. 2 KUVERA. E. हरि tawny or green, and अक्षि the eye, षच् aff.
हर्य्यक्ष: हर्य्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A lion. 2 KUVERA. E. हरि tawny or green, and अक्षि the eye, षच् aff.
हर्यत: हर्य्यत m. (-तः) 1 A horse. 2 A steed fit for an Aśvamedha. E. हृ to take, अतच् Uṇādi aff.
हर्य्यत: हर्य्यत m. (-तः) 1 A horse. 2 A steed fit for an Aśvamedha. E. हृ to take, अतच् Uṇādi aff.
हर्ष: हर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Happy, delighted. m. (-र्षः) Joy, pleasure, delight, happiness. E. हृष to be pleased, aff. अच् or घञ्.
हर्षक: हर्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Delighting, pleasing, delightful. m. (-कः) The name of a mountain. E. हृष to please, aff. ण्वुल्.
हर्षकर: हर्षकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Causing delight, gratifying, delighting. E. हर्ष, and कर who or what makes.
हर्षण: हर्षण mfn. (-णः-णा or णी-णं) Causing delight, delighting, delightful, pleasurable, pleasant, &c. m. (-णः) 1 A cause of pleasure, any thing which confers pleasure. 2 The fourteenth of the astronomical Yogas. 3 A morbid affection of the eyes. 4 A deity presiding over Śrāddhas. 5 A kind of Śrāddha. n. (-णं) 1 Pleasing, making happy. 2 Rejoicing, being happy. E. हृष to be pleased, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
हर्षमाण: हर्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Joyful, cheerful, happy. E. हृष to be pleased, शानच् aff.
हर्षयित्नु: हर्षयित्नु mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु) Causing delight, delighting. m. (-त्नुः) A son, a child. n. (-त्नु) Gold. E. हृष to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. इत्नुच्.
हर्षविह्वल: हर्षविह्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Overjoyed. E. हर्ष, and विह्वल agitated.
हर्षसमन्वित: हर्षसमन्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Joyful. E. हर्ष, and समन्वित possessed of.
हर्षस्वन: हर्षस्वन m. (-नः) A cry or sound expressing joy or pleasure. E. हर्ष gladness, and स्वन sound.
हर्षित: हर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Happy, delighted, gladdened, made glad or happy. E. हर्ष, and इतच् aff., or हृष to be pleased, causal v., क्त aff.
हर्षुल: हर्षुल n. (-लः) 1 A deer. 2 A lover. E. हृष to be pleased, उलच् Uṇādi aff.
हर्षोत्कर्ष: हर्षोत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Great happiness. E. हर्ष, and उत्कर्ष eminence.
हर्षोदय: हर्षोदय m. (-यः) Appearance or occurrence of happiness. E. हर्ष, and उदय rising.
हल: हल n. (-लं) A plough. f. (-ला) 1 Vinous liquor. 2 The earth. 3 Water. E. हल to plough, aff. अच्.
हलधर: हलधर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Holding or having a plough. m. (-रः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. हस्न, and धर who holds or has.
हलभृत्: हलभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Having a plough. m. (-भृत्) A name of BALARĀMA. E. हल a plough, and भृत् possessing.
हलभृति: हलभृति m. (-तिः) 1 Agriculture. 2 A saint so named. E. हल a plough, and भृति having.
हलहति: हलहति f. (-तिः) Ploughing, furrowing. E. हल, and हति striking.
हलहलाशब्द: हलहलाशब्द m. (-ब्दः) Noise, tumult. E. हलहला imitative sound, शब्द sound.
हला: हला ind. A vocative particle, addressed in theatrical language to a female friend. E. हल to plough, आ aff.
हलायुध: हलायुध m. (-धः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. हल a plough, आयुध a weapon.
हलाह: हलाह m. (-हः) A horse of mixed colour; also read हालाह.
हलाहल: हलाहल mn. (-लः-लं) A sort of poison. m. (-लः) 1 A kind of snake. 2 A Jaina or Bauddha deified saint. 3 A sort of lizard or newt. E. हस्न to plough, अच् aff., अ negative, and हल the same; also हलहस्न, &c.
हलि: हलि m. (-लिः) 1 A furrow. 2 Agriculture. E. हस्न to plough, इन् aff.
हलिन्: हलिन् m. (-ली) 1 BALADEVA. 2 A ploughman, a cultivator. f. (-नी) A plant, commonly Lāṅgalīya. E. हस्न a plough, इनि aff.
हलिप्रिय: हलिप्रिय m. (-यः) The Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba.) f. (-या) Spirituous liquor. E. हस्नि BALARĀMA, and प्रिय beloved.
हलीन: हलीन m. (-नः) The teak tree. E. हस्न a plough, ख aff.
हलीमक: हलीमक n. (-कं) A sort of jaundice.
हल्य: हल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Ploughed, tilled. f. (-ल्या) A multitude of ploughs. m. (-ल्यः) Ploughing. E. हस्न a plough, यत् aff.
हल्लक: हल्लक n. (-कं) The red lotus. E. ह्लाद to delight, ण्वुल् aff.; form irr.
हल्लन: हल्लन n. (-नं) Rolling or tossing as in sleep.
हल्लीष: हल्लीष n. (-षं) 1 A minor dramatic entertainment, chiefly of singing and dancing by one male and eight or ten female performers, a ballet. 2 A dance performed by women in a circle. E. हेला wanton sport, लष् or स्नस to be skilful, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.; also हल्लीस.
हल्लीषक: हल्लीषक m. (-कं) Dancing in a ring as performed by women. E. कन् added to हल्लीस or हल्लीष, whence it is also read हल्लीसक.
हल्लीस: हल्लीस n. (-सं) A dramatic entertainment, &c.: see हल्लीष.
हव: हव m. (-वः) 1 Sacrifice, oblation. 2 Call, calling. 3 Order, command. 4 Challenging, defying. E. हु to sacrifice, or ह्वे to call, अप् aff.
हवङ्ग: हवङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Eating rice and curds from a cup of bell-metal. E. हव sacrifice, गम to go, aff. खश्.
हवन: हवन m. (-नः) Sacrifice, offering, oblation. f. (-नी) A hole in the ground for receiving a sacrificial fire. E. हु to sacrifice, ल्युट्. or युच् aff.
हवनायुस्: हवनायुस् m. (-युः) Fire. E. हवन burnt-offering, and आयुस् life.
हवनीय: हवनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be offered with fire, fit for an oblation, &c. n. (-यं) Ghee. E. हु to sacrifice, अनीयर् aff.
हवा: हवा or हवाव ind. A term implying undoubtedly, certainly: see हि.
हविःशेष: हविःशेष m. (-षः) The residue of an oblation of Ghee or clarified butter. E. हविस्, and शेष rest.
हवित्री: हवित्री f. (-त्री) A hole in the ground for containing a sacrificial fire. E. हु to sacrifice, इत्रन् aff.
हविरशन: हविरशन m. (-नः) Fire. E. हविस् Ghee, अशन food.
हविर्गेह: हविर्गेह n. (-हं) A room in which a burnt-offering is made, a place of sacrifice. E. हविस् Ghee, and गेह a house or apartment.
हविर्भुज्: हविर्भुज् m. (-भुक्) Fire. E. हविस्, and भुज् who eats.
हविर्याजिन्: हविर्याजिन् m. (-जी) A priest. E. हविस्, and याजिन् who offers.
हविष्य: हविष्य n. (-ष्यं) 1 Clarified butter. 2 Rice mixed with Ghee. E. हविस् an oblation, यत् aff. of fitness.
हविष्यभुज्: हविष्यभुज् m. (-भुक्) Fire. E. हविष्य, and भुज् who eats; also हविष्याशिन्, &c.
हविस्: हविस् n. (-विः) 1 Clarified butter. 2 An intended oblation, the article to be so offered, usually clarified butter. 3 Water. E. हु to offer in oblation, असि Uṇādi aff.
हव्य: हव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Fit or proper to be offered in oblation. n. (-व्यं) 1 An offering to the gods. 2 Ghee. E. हु to sacrifice, यत् aff.
हव्यपाक: हव्यपाक m. (-कः) 1 An oblation dressed for the deities. 2 The vessel in which it is prepared. E. हव्य an offering to the gods, and पाक cooking.
हव्यवाह: हव्यवाह m. (-हः) Fire. E. हव्य an oblation, and वाह who bears.
हव्यवाहन: हव्यवाहन m. (-नः) Fire. E. हव्य an oblation, and वाहन vehicle.
हव्याश: हव्याश m. (-शः) Fire. E. हव्य an oblation, and अश who eats.
हव्याशन: हव्याशन m. (-नः) AGNI or fire. E. हव्य a burnt offering, and अशन food.
हस: हस (ए) हसे r. 1st cl. (हसति) 1 To laugh. 2 To laugh at, to ridicule: (this root does not take the middle voice when it implies reciprocal action, as व्यतिहसन्ति they laugh at each other.)
हस m. (-सः) Laughter, laughing, laugh. E. हस to laugh, aff. अप्.
हसत्: हसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Laughing, smiling. f. (-न्ती) 1 A portable fire-pan, a small furnace. 2 Arabian jasmine. 3 A Śākinī or female spirit attendant on DURGĀ. E. हस to laugh, aff. शतृ.
हसन: हसन n. (-नं) Laughter, laughing. f. (-नी) A portable fire-place or pan. E. हस to laugh, aff. ल्युट्.
हसनीमणि: हसनीमणि m. (-णिः) AGNI or fire. E. हसनी a fire-place, and मणि a jewel.
हसन्तिका: हसन्तिका f. (-का) A portable furnace or fire-pan. E. कन् added to हसन्ती; see हसत्.
हसिका: हसिका f. (-का) Laughter. E. हस to laugh, ण्वुल् aff.
हसित: हसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blown, budded, (as a flower.) 2 Smiling, n. (-तं) 1 Laughter. 2 Smiling. 3 The bow of KĀMA. E. हस to laugh, aff. क्त.
हस्त: हस्त m. (-स्तः) 1 The hand. 2 An elephant's trunk. 3 The thirteenth lunar asterism, designated by a hand, and containing five stars, one of which is γ or δ Corvi. 4 A head of hair, or abundance of hair. 5 A cubit measured by the hand and arm, or from the elbow to the tip of the middle finger. 6 (In prosody,) An anapæst. n. (-स्तं) A bellows. E. हस to laugh, Uṇādi aff. तन्.
हस्तच्छेदन: हस्तछेदन n. (-नं) Cutting off the hand. E. हस्त, and छेदन cutting.
हस्तछेदन: हस्तछेदन n. (-नं) Cutting off the hand. E. हस्त, and छेदन cutting.
हस्ततल: हस्ततल n. (-लं) 1 The palm of the hand. 2 The hand. 3 The tip of an elephant's trunk. E. हस्त, and तल surface.
हस्तधारण: हस्तधारण n. (-णं) Warding off a blow, stopping, resisting, (in a conflict.) E. हस्त the hand, and धारण restraining.
हस्तपुच्छ: हस्तपुच्छ n. (-च्छं) The hand below the wrist. E. हस्त the hand, and पुच्छ tail.
हस्तवर्तिन्: हस्तवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) In hand, seized, held, caught hold of. E. हस्त, and वर्त्तिन what abides.
हस्तवर्त्तिन्: हस्तवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) In hand, seized, held, caught hold of. E. हस्त, and वर्त्तिन what abides.
हस्तवारण: हस्तवारण n. (-णं) Resisting an assault, warding off a blow. E. हस्त the hand, and वारण prohibiting.
हस्तविम्ब: हस्तविम्ब n. (-म्बं) Perfuming the person. E. हस्त the hand, and विम्ब a red fruit.
हस्तसूत्र: हस्तसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A bracelet, one worn at the wrist. E. हस्त the hand, and सूत्र a string.
हस्तस्थ: हस्तस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) In hand, held, grasped. E. हस्त, and स्थ what stays or is.
हस्तस्थित: हस्तस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Held, in hand. E. हस्त, and स्थित staying.
हस्तिकक्ष्य: हस्तिकक्ष्य m. (-क्ष्यः) 1 A lion. 2 A tiger. E. हस्ति an elephant, कश to hurt, स aff., and यत् added.
हस्तिकर्ण: हस्तिकर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 The castor oil tree. 2 The Butea frondosa. 3 A demi-god of a particular class. E. हस्तिन् an elephant, and कर्ण the ear.
हस्तिकर्णक: हस्तिकर्णक m. (-कः) A tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. कन् added to the last.
हस्तिकर्णदल: हस्तिकर्णदल m. (-लः) A sort of Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa.) E. हस्ति an elephant, कर्ण the ear, and दल a leaf.
हस्तिकोलि: हस्तिकोलि m. (-लिः) A sort of jujube. E. हस्ति an elephant, and कोलि jujube.
हस्तिगिरि: हस्तिगिरि m. (-रिः) The city Kāñci, a place of pilgrimage in the peninsula. E. हस्ति an elephant, and गिरि a mountain.
हस्तिघोषा: हस्तिघोषा f. (-षा) A kind of creeper. E. हस्ति an elephant, and घोषा the generic name.
हस्तिघ्न: हस्तिघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A man. E. हस्ति an elephant, घ्न who kills.
हस्तिचारिन्: हस्तिचारिन् m. (-री) An elephant-driver. E. हस्ति, and चारिन् who gives.
हस्तिदन्त: हस्तिदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 The radish. 2 A pin or bracket projecting from a wall to hang any thing upon. n. (-न्तं) Ivory. E. हस्ति an elephant, and दन्त a tooth; also with कन् added, हस्तिदन्तक.
हस्तिद्वयस: हस्तिद्वयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) As big as an elephant, gigantic, elephantine. E. हस्ति an elephant, द्वयसच् aff.
हस्तिन्: हस्तिन् m. (-स्ती) An elephant. f. (-नी) 1 A female elephant. 2 A female; one of the four kinds into which they are classed, and described as of low stature, corpulent habits, curly hair, dark complexion, libidinous appetite, and furious passions. 3 A drug and perfume; also हट्टविस्नासिनी. E. हस्त a trunk, and इनि aff.
हस्तिनख: हस्तिनख n. (-खं) A sort of covered way, a raised place of earth or masonry, covering the access to the gate of a city or fort. E. हस्ति an elephant, and नख nail.
हस्तिनापुर: हस्तिनापुर n. (-रं) Ancient Dehli, the capital of YUDHIṢṬHIRA and his brethren, the remains of which still exist, about 57  miles north-east of the modern city, on the banks of the old channel of the Ganges. E. हस्तिन् the name of a king, its founder, or an elephant, &c., and पुर city; also हस्तिनीपुर.
हस्तिप: हस्तिप m. (-पः) An elephant rider or driver. E. हस्तिन् an elephant, पाल to cherish or rear, aff. क.
हस्तिपक: हस्तिपक m. (-कः) An elephant-driver or keeper. E. हस्तिप the same, and कन् aff.
हस्तिपर्णी: हस्तिपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A plant, commonly Moraṭā. 2 A sort of gourd, (Momordica mixta.) E. हस्ति an elephant, and पर्ण leaf.
हस्तिमद: हस्तिमद m. (-दः) The juice that exudes from an elephant's temples when in rut. E. हस्ति an elephant, and मद the frontal juice.
हस्तिमल्ल: हस्तिमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) 1 GAṆEŚA. 2 ŚAṄKHA, the eighth of the chief Nāgas or serpents of the infernal regions. 3 The elephant of INDRA. 4 A heap of ashes. 5 A shower of dust. 6 Frost, cold. E. हस्ति an elephant, and मल्ल a wrestler.
हस्तिवाह: हस्तिवाह m. (-हः) A goad. E. हस्ति an elephant, and वाह what bears.
हस्तिशाला: हस्तिशाला f. (-ला) An elephant stall or stable. E. हस्ति an elephant, and शाला hall.
हस्तिशुण्डा: हस्तिशुण्डा f. (-ण्डा or ण्डी) 1 An elephant's trunk. 2 A flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) E. हस्ति an elephant, शुण्डा the trunk.
हस्तेकरण: हस्तेकरण n. (-णं) Marriage. E. हस्त the hand in the seventh case, and करण making.
हस्त्य: हस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) 1 Given with the hand. 2 Done with the hand, manual. E. हस्त the hand, यत् aff.
हस्त्यारोह: हस्त्यारोह m. (-हः) An elephant rider or driver. E. हस्ति an elephant, and आरोह who mounts.
हस्र: हस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) Stupid, ignorant, a fool. E. हस to laugh at or deride, रक् Uṇādi aff.
हहल: हहल n. (-लं) A sort of poison.
हहा: हहा m. (-हा) A Gandharba or chorister of heaven; also हाहा
हा: हा r. 3rd cl. (ओ क,) ओहाक् (जहाति) 1 To quit, to leave, to abandon. 2 To wander or deviate: (ओ ड,) ओहाङ् (जिहते) To go, to move.
हा ind. 1 An interjection of weariness. 2 Of sorrow, pain. 3 An exclamation of pleasure. 4 A term of reproach. E. हा to abandon, aff. क्विप्; the word corresponds to ah, alas, oh, ha, &c.
हाटक: हाटक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Golden, of gold, (as a weight or coin.) n. (-कं) Gold. E. हट to shine, ण्वुल् aff.
हाटकमय: हाटकमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of gold, golden. E. हाटक gold, मयट् aff.
हातव्य: हातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be abandoned, to be left. E. हा to abandon, तव्यर् aff.
हात्र: हात्र n. (-त्रं) Wages, hire. E. हन to hurt, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
हान: हान n. (-नं) 1 Abandoning, relinquishing. 2 Prowess, valour. E. हा to leave, ल्युट् aff.
हानि: हानि f. (-निः) Loss, privation, abandonment, relinquishment. E. हा to leave, Uṇādi aff. नि.
हानुक: हानुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mischievous, hurting, killing. E. हन to hurt or kill, उकञ् aff.
हान्द्र: हान्द्र n. (-न्द्रं) Death, dying. E. हन to kill, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
हायन: हायन mn. (-नः-नं) A year. m. (-नः) 1 A flame, a ray. 2 A sort of rice. E. हा to go or leave, ल्युट् aff., युक् augment.
हार: हार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what takes, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A porter, a carrier. 2 Taking, conveying. 3 A string or garland of pearls, &c. 4 War, battle. 5 (In prosody,) A long syllable. 6 (In arithmetic,) A divisor, also the denominator of a fraction. E. हृ to seize, (the mind, &c.) and घञ् aff., or causal form, with अण् aff.
हारक: हारक m. (-कः) 1 A thief. 2 A cheat, a rogue. 3 Prose. 4 Science. 5 A gambler. 6 A tree, (Trophis aspera.) 7 A plunderer, a ravisher, one who carries off any thing. 8 (In arithmetic,) A divisor. E. हृ to take, aff. ण्वुल्.
हारयष्टि: हारयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A necklace. E. हार, and यष्टि a staff.
हारहूर: हारहूर n. (-रं) Wine, vinous liquor. f. (-रा) A grape.
हारि: हारि mfn. (-रिः-रिः or -री-रि) Handsome, charming. f. (-रिः) 1 Defeat, discomfiture, either in war or gambling, &c. 2 A traveller's progeny or family. f. (-री) A pearl. E. हृ to take or steal, aff. इञ्, optionally in the fem. form ङीष् added.
हारिकण्ठ: हारिकण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठी-ण्ठं) Wearing or having a necklace. m. (-ण्ठः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. हारि for हार a necklace, कण्ठ the throat.
हारिण: हारिण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Relating to deer, (deer-flesh, skin, &c.) E. हरिण, and अण् aff.
हारिणिक: हारिणिक m. (-कः) A hunter, a deer-killer. f. (-की) A species of the Atyaṣṭi metre. E. हरिण a deer, ठक् aff.
हारित: हारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lost, relinquished, made away with. m. (-तः) 1 The green or wood pigeon. 2 Green, the colour. E. हृ to take, causal v., क्त aff., or हरित् green, अण् aff.
हारितक: हारितक n. (-कं) A potherb. E. हरित the same, ठन् aff.
हारिद्र: हारिद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) 1 Stained, dyed, or coloured with turmeric. 2 Yellow. m. (-द्रः) 1 The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea Cadamba.) 2 Yellow, (the colour.) E. हरिद्रा turmeric, and अण् or अञ् aff.
हारिन्: हारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Taking, getting, who takes or gets. 2 Pleasant, agreeable. E. हृ to take, aff. णिनि.
हारीत: हारीत m. (-तः) 1 The green or wood pigeon, (Columba hariala, BUC.) 2 A Muni, and legislator. 3 Roguery, cheating, fraud. E. हार a necklace, or हारि defeat, and इत gone, got; or हरित green, अण् aff., and the vowel made long.
हार्द: हार्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) Affection, kindness. E. हृद the heart, अण् aff.
हार्द्द: हार्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) Affection, kindness. E. हृद the heart, अण् aff.
हार्य: हार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be taken, to be taken away. m. (-र्य्यः) Beleric myrobalan. E. हृ to take, aff. ण्यत्.
हार्य्य: हार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be taken, to be taken away. m. (-र्य्यः) Beleric myrobalan. E. हृ to take, aff. ण्यत्.
हाल: हाल m. (-लः) 1 BALARĀMA. 2 A name of ŚĀLIVĀHANA. 3 A plough. f. (-ला) Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor. (-ली) A wife's younger sister. E. हाल a plough, aff. अण्, or हल to plough, aff. घञ्.
हालक: हालक m. (-कः) A horse of a yellowish red, or tawny colour.
हालहल: हालहल n. (-लं) A sort of poison: see the next.
हालहाल: हालहाल n. (-लं) A sort of poison; also variously read हलाहलं, हस्नहलं, हास्नाहलं.
हालाहल: हालाहल n. (-लं) A sort of poison: see हास्नहाल. f. (-स्ना) A small mouse. f. (-ली) Wine, spirituous liquor. m. (-लः) A sort of worm or insect, a kind of newt.
हालाहलधर: हालाहलधर m. (-रः) A small black and venomous snake. E. हालाहल poison, and धर having.
हालिक: हालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a plough, as a ploughman, cattle, &c. E. हल a plough, ठञ् or ठक् aff.
हालिनी: हालिनी f. (-नी) A sort of lizard.
हालु: हालु m. (-लुः) A tooth. E. हल to plough, उण् Uṇādi aff.
हाव: हाव m. (-वः) 1 Any feminine act of amorous pastime, or tending to excite amorous sensations, coquetry, blandishment, dalliance. 2 Calling. E. ह्वेञ् to call, (to incite passion,) घञ् aff.
हास: हास m. (-सः) Laughing, laughter. E. हस to laugh, aff. घञ्.
हासक: हासक m. (-कः) A buffoon. E. हस to laugh, causal v., वुन् aff.
हासकर: हासकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Laughing, laughing at. 2 Causing laughter, merry, ridiculous. E. हास, कर what makes.
हासस्: हासस् m. (-साः) The moon, (in the language of the Vedas. E. हा to abandon, असुन् aff., and सुट् augment.
हासिका: हासिका f. (-का) Laughter, mirth. E. हस to laugh, ण्वुल् aff.
हासिन्: हासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Laughing, smiling. E. हस to laugh, घिनुण् aff.
हास्तिक: हास्तिक n. (-कं) A herd of elephants. m. (-कः) A rider on an elephant, an elephant-driver, &c. E. हस्तिन् an elephant, ठक् aff.
हास्तिन: हास्तिन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Elephantine, large, as big as an elephant, &c. n. (-नं) Hastināpura, ancient Dehli. E. हस्तिन् a sovereign, founder of the city, or an elephant, and अण् aff. of derivation, or abundance.
हास्तिनपुर: हास्तिनपुर n. (-रं) Hastināpura. E. हास्तिन the same, and पुर city.
हास्य: हास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Laughable, ridiculous. n. (-स्यं) Laughter. laughing, mirth. E. हस to laugh, and ण्यत् aff.
हाहल: हाहल n. (-लं) A sort of poison: see हलाहल.
हाहस्: हाहस् m. (-हाः) A Gandharba, a celestial being of an inferior order.
हाहा: हाहा m. (-हाः) A Gandharba, a demi-god of an inferior order, attendant on KUVERA and the other gods, and especially the chanter of their praises. ind. An interjection of surprise, or grief, or pain. E. हा alas, interjection of sorrow, हा to abandon, क्विप् aff., or with असि, aff. हाहस्, or हा interjection repeated.
हाहाकार: हाहाकार m. (-रः) 1 The noise or uproar of battle. 2 Lamentation, sound of grief or pity. E. हाहा interjection of pain, कार making.
हाहाल: हाहाल n. (-लं) A sort of poison: see हलाहल.
हि: हि r. 5th cl. (हिनोति) 1 To go. 2 To send. 3 To grow or increase. 4 To be in pain.

हि ind. 1 Because, for, on account of. 2 Assembly, certainly, (assertion.) 3 Indeed, surely, (interrogation.) 4 A particle, implying difference or distinction. 5 An expletive. 6 Ah, alas. 7 An interjection of envy or contempt. 8 An interjection of hurry. E. हि to go, विच् aff.
हिंसक: हिंसक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Mischievous, malignant, ferocious, savage. m. (-कः) 1 A beast of prey. 2 An enemy. 3 A Brahman, who has studied the Atharvan Veda. E. हिसि to injure, वुञ् aff.
हिंसन: हिंसन n. (-नं) Injuring, hurting. E. हिसि to hurt, ल्युट् aff.
हिंसा: हिंसा f. (-सा) 1 Injury, mischief, &c.; it is usually distinguished as of three sorts, mental, (as malice,) verbal, (abuse,) personal, (striking, wounding, beating, &c.) 2 Slaughter, killing, slaying. E. हिंसि to hurt or kill, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
हिंसाकर्मन्: हिंसाकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Incantation to destroy, or the practice of magic, or employment of mystical texts for malevolent and injurious purposes. 2 Any mischievous or malevolent act. E. हिंसा injury, and कर्म्मन् act.
हिंसाकर्म्मन्: हिंसाकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Incantation to destroy, or the practice of magic, or employment of mystical texts for malevolent and injurious purposes. 2 Any mischievous or malevolent act. E. हिंसा injury, and कर्म्मन् act.
हिंसात्मक: हिंसात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Injurious. E. हिंसा, and आत्मक self.
हिंसारु: हिंसारु m. (-रुः) A tiger. E. हिंसा injury, ऋ to go or affect, aff. उण्.
हिंसालु: हिंसालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Mischievous, hurtful. E. हिंसा injury, and आलुच् aff.
हिंसालुक: हिंसालुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Mischievous, hurtful. m. (-कः) A mischievous or savage dog. E. कन् added to the last.
हिंसीर: हिंसीर m. (-रः) 1 A tiger. 2 A wretch, a villain. E. हिसि to hurt or kill, Uṇādi aff. ईरन् or ईरच्.
हिंस्र: हिंस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) 1 Mischievous, hurtful, injurious. 2 Murderous. 3 Formidable, terrible. 4 Fierce, savage. m. (-स्रः) 1 BHĪMA. 2 ŚIVA. 3 A beast of prey. f. (-स्रा) 1 Spikenard (Valeriana Jaṭāmāṃsī.) 2 A shrub, (Abrus precatorious.) 3 A sort of grain, (Coix barbata.) 4 A vein, a nerve. E. हिसि to hurt, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
हिंस्रक: हिंस्रक m. (-कः) A beast of prey. E. कन् added to the last.
हिंस्रपशु: हिंस्रपशु m. (-शुः) A beast of prey. E. हिंस्र mischievous, and पशु an animal.
हिक्क: हिक्क r. 1st cl. (हिक्कति-ते) 1 To sound inarticulately. 2 To hiccough. r. 10th cl. (हिक्कयते) To hurt or injure.
हिक्का: हिक्का f. (-क्का) Hiccough. E. हिक्क to hiccough, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
हिङ्कार: हिङ्कार m. (-रः) A tiger. E. हिं imitative sound, and कार who makes.
हिङ्गु: हिङ्गु mn. (-ङ्गुः-ङ्गु) Asafoetida. E. हि to go, deriv. irr., or हिम frost, गम to go, डु aff., form irr.
हिङ्गुनिर्यास: हिङ्गुनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) 1 The Nimb tree. 2 Asafoetida, (the gum.) E. हिङ्गु asafoetida, and निर्य्यास exudation.
हिङ्गुनिर्य्यास: हिङ्गुनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) 1 The Nimb tree. 2 Asafoetida, (the gum.) E. हिङ्गु asafoetida, and निर्य्यास exudation.
हिङ्गुपची: हिङ्गुपची f. (-ची) A leaf, and drug, perhaps the leaf of the asafoetida plant. E. हिङ्गु asafoetida, and पत्र a leaf.
हिङ्गुपर्णी: हिङ्गुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, commonly Banspatri. E. हिङ्गु asafoetida, and पर्ण leaf.
हिङ्गुल: हिङ्गुल m. (-लः) Vermilion. f. (-ली) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena). E. हिङ्गु asafoetida, स्ना to take or give, aff. क.
हिङ्गुलि: हिङ्गुलि m. (-लिः) Vermilion. E. हिङ्गु asafœtida, स्ना to take or give, aff. कि.
हिङ्गुलिका: हिङ्गुलिका f. (-का) A prickly night-shade, (Solanum Jacquini.) E. हिङ्गुली the egg-plant, कन् added.
हिङ्गुलु: हिङ्गुलु mn. (-लुः-लु) Vermilion. E. हिङ्गु asafœtida, स्ना to give or take, aff. डु.
हिङ्गुशिराटिका: हिङ्गुशिराटिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Banspatri.
हिङ्गूल: हिङ्गूल n. (-लं) An esculent root, a sort of yam.
हिज्जस्न: हिज्जस्न m. (-लः) A plant, commonly Hijjal, (Barringtonia acutangula).
हिञ्जीर: हिञ्जीर m. (-रः) A rope or chain for an elephant's feet.
हिड: हिड (इ) हिडि r. 1st cl. (हिण्डते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To disregard or disrespect.
हिडिम्ब: हिडिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A prince of the Rākṣasas slain by BHĪMA. f. (-म्बा) The sister of Hiḍimbā carried off by BHĪMA: these names are also read हिडम्ब, हिडम्बा.
हिडिम्बजित्: हिडिम्बजित् m. (-जित्) BHĪMA, the second of the Pāṇḍus. E. हिडिम्ब a Rākṣasa, and जित् conqueror; also similar compounds, as हिडिम्बनिसूदनः, हिडिम्बभिद्.
हिडिम्बभिद्: हिडिम्बभिद् m. (-भित् or भिद्) BHĪMA; see the last.
हिडिम्बापति: हिडिम्बापति m. (-तिः) 1 HANUMĀN. 2 BHĪMA. E. हिडिम्बा a female Rākṣasa, and पति husband.
हिडिम्बारमण: हिडिम्बारमण m. (-णः) 1 HANUMĀN, the monkey friend and ally of RĀMA. 2 BHĪMA. E. हिडिम्बा a female Rākṣasa, and रमण husband.
हिण्डन: हिण्डन n. (-नं) 1 Wandering, roaming. 2 Copulation. 3 Writing. E. हिडि to go, ल्युट् aff.
हिण्डिक: हिण्डिक m. (-कः) An astrologer. E. हिडि to go, aff. अच्, and ठक् added.
हिण्डिर: हिण्डिर m. (-रः) Cuttle fish bone. E. हिडि to go, or despise, aff. इरन्; also हिण्डीर.
हिण्डी: हिण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A name of DURGĀ. E. हिडि to go, or despise, (the Asuras,) अच् aff., and ङीष् added.
हिण्डीप्रियतम: हिण्डीप्रियतम m. (-मः) ŚIVA. E. हिण्डी DURGĀ, and प्रियतम dearest.
हिण्डीर: हिण्डीर m. (-रः) 1 Cuttle fish bone, considered to be the indurated foam of the sea. 2 A man, a male. 3 The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) 4 A tonic or stomachic. E. हिडि to go, or despise, aff. ईरन्.
हित: हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं). 1 Suitable, proper, fit, worthy, right. 2 Gone, proceeded. 3 Held, taken, seized, placed. 4 (In medicine,) Proper, as diet or menstrua, suitable to the case or the medicines taken. 5 Friendly, affectionate, kind. 6 Useful. m. (-तः) A good, a benefit. (-ता) A causeway, a dike. E. धा to have or hold, क्त aff.
हितकर: हितकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Friendly, kind, favourable. m. (-रः) A benefactor. E. हित, and कर who does.
हितकाम: हितकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Wishing well to, kind or friendly to. E. हित, and काम desire.
हितकाम्या: हितकाम्या f. (-म्या) Concern for another's welfare. E. हित, and काम्या desire.
हितप्रणी: हितप्रणी m. (-णीः) A spy, a secret emissary. E. हित proper, and प्रणी who instructs.
हितप्रेप्सु: हितप्रेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Benevolent, benign. E. हित, and प्रेप्सु wishing.
हितबुद्धि: हितबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Well-disposed to, wishing well to. E. हित, and बुद्धि understanding.
हितवत्: हितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Friendly, favourable, doing good to. E. हित, and मतुप् aff.
हितवादिन्: हितवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Giving good counsel, directing or advising what is right. m. (-दी) A director, an adviser. E. हित proper, and वादिन् speaking.
हितानुकारिन्: हितानुकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Kind. E. हित, and अनुकारिन् who acts conformably to.
हितान्वेषिन्: हितान्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Seeking another's welfare. E. हित, and अन्वेषिन् who seeks.
हिताहित: हिताहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Good and evil, beneficial and disadvantageous. E. हित, and अहित bad.
हितैषिन्: हितैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Wishing well to. E. हित, and एषिन् who desires.
हितोक्ति: हितोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Compassion, clemency, tenderness. 2 Good advice. E. हित kind, and उक्ति speech.
हितोपदेश: हितोपदेश m. (-शः) Friendly or proper advice. E. हित proper, and उपदेश advice.
हित्वा: हित्वा ind. Having left or abandoned. E. हा to leave, क्त्वा aff.
हिन्ताल: हिन्ताल m. (-लः) The marshy date tree, (Phoenix or Elate paludosa.) E. हीन defective, i. e. small, ताल the palm, deriv. irr.
हिन्दोल: हिन्दोल m. (-लः) 1 A swing. 2 One of the Rāgas or personified musical modes. E. हि particle, दुल to shake, घञ् aff., deriv. irr.
हिन्दोलक: हिन्दोलक m. (-कः) A swing. E. हि particle, दुल to shake, aff. घञ्, and कन् added.
हिम: हिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Cold, frigid. n. (-मं) 1 Frost, snow. 2 Cold. 3 Sandal. 4 Fresh butter. 5 Tin. 6 A pearl. 7 A lotus. m. (-मः) 1 The Sandal tree. 2 The moon. 3 Camphor. 4 The Himālaya mountain. f. (-मा) 1 Small cardamoms. 2 Reṇukā, a perfume. 3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) E. हन to hurt, मक् Uṇādi aff., and हि substituted for the root.
हिमऋतु: हिमऋतु m. (-तुः) The cold season. E. हिम, and ऋतु season.
हिमकर: हिमकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Frigorific, cold. m. (-रः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. हिम cold, and कर who makes, or a ray.
हिमकूट: हिमकूट m. (-टः) Winter. E. हिम frost or cold, and कूट a quantity.
हिमज: हिमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by cold, in the Himālaya, &c. m. (-जः) 1 The mountain Maināka. f. (-जा) 1 PĀRVATĪ. 2 Zedoary. E. हिम the Himāla personified, and ज born.
हिमज्झटि: हिमज्झटि f. (-टिः) Mist, dew, fog. E. हिम cold, ज्झट to be entangled, इ aff.
हिमदुर्दिन: हिमदुर्द्दिन n. (-नं) Winter, wintry weather, frost and snow. E. हिम cold, and दुर्द्दिन bad weather.
हिमदुर्द्दिन: हिमदुर्द्दिन n. (-नं) Winter, wintry weather, frost and snow. E. हिम cold, and दुर्द्दिन bad weather.
हिमद्युति: हिमद्युति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. हिम cold, cooling, and द्युति radiance.
हिमप्रस्थ: हिमप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) The Himālaya mountains. E. हिम cold, and प्रस्थ abode.
हिमबालुका: हिमबालुका f. (-का) Camphor. E. हिम cold, and बालुका sand.
हिमवत्: हिमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Cold, freezing, chilly, frosty. m. (-वान्) The Himālaya range. E. हिम cold, and मतुप् aff.
हिमवत्सुत: हिमवत्सुत m. (-तः) 1 The mountain Maināka. f. (-ता) 1 The Ganges. 2 PĀRVATĪ. E. हिमवत् the Himālaya, and सुत son, or सुता daughter.
हिमशीतल: हिमशीतल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Very cold, frosty, freezing. E. हिम, and शीतल cold.
हिमशैलजा: हिमशैलजा f. (-जा) The goddess DURGĀ or PĀRVATĪ. E. हिमशैल the snowy mountains, and जा daughter.
हिमश्रथ: हिमश्रथ m. (-थः) The moon. E. हिम, and श्रथि to shed, अच् aff.
हिमसंहति: हिमसंहति f. (-तिः) Ice and snow. E. हिम cold, संहति assemblage.
हिमहानकृत्: हिमहानकृत् m. (-त्) Fire. E. हिम, हान loss, कृत् what makes.
हिमहासक: हिमहासक m. (-कः) The marshy date tree. E. हिम cold or winter, and हासक smiling.
हिमांशु: हिमांशु m. (-शुः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. हिम cold, अंशु a ray.
हिमांश्वभिख्य: हिमांश्वभिख्य n. (-ख्या) Silver. E. हिमांशु the moon, अभिख्या appellation.
हिमागम: हिमागम m. (-मः) The cold season, winter. E. हिम cold or frost, and आगम arrival.
हिमाद्रि: हिमाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The snowy range of mountains, skirting the north of India, the Imaus or Emodus. E. हिम cold, and अद्रि a mountain.
हिमानी: हिमानी f. (-नी) Ice and snow. E. हिम cold, ङीष् aff., and आनुक augment.
हिमानिल: हिमानिल m. (-लः) A frosty or cold wind. E. हिम, and अनिल wind.
हिमाभ: हिमाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Like frost and snow. E. हिम, and आभ resembling.
हिमाराति: हिमाराति m. (-तिः) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. E. हिम cold, अराति the enemy; also similar compounds, as, &c.
हिमार्त: हिमार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Chilly, cold, suffering from cold. E. हिम, and आर्त्त pained.
हिमार्त्त: हिमार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Chilly, cold, suffering from cold. E. हिम, and आर्त्त pained.
हिमालय: हिमालय m. (-यः) The Himāla or Himālaya range of mountains, which bounds India on the north, and separates it from Tartary; the Imaus and Emodus of the ancients, giving rise to the Ganges, and Indus, and many other considerable rivers, and containing the highest elevations in the world: in mythology, the mountain is personified as the husband of MENAKĀ, and the father of GAṄGĀ or the Ganges, and DURGĀ or UMĀ in her descent as PĀRVATĪ, the mountain nymph, to captivate ŚIVA, and withdraw him from a course of ascetic austerity practised in those regions. E. हिम cold, or frost and snow, and आस्नय abode.
हिमावती: हिमावती f. (-ती) A sort of moon-plant; also स्वर्णक्षीर.
हिमाह्व: हिमाह्व m. (-ह्वः) Camphor. E. हिम snow, आह्व appellation.
हिमाह्वय: हिमाह्वय m. (-यः) Camphor. n. (-यं) A lotus. E. हिम cold, आह्वय appellation.
हिमिका: हिमिका f. (-का) Hoar frost. E. हिम frost, कन् aff., fem. form.
हिमेलु: हिमेलु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Suffering from cold, chilly, frozen. E. हिम cold, एलु aff.
हिम्य: हिम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Frozen, snowy, cold, frigid. E. हिम frost and snow, and यत् aff.
हिरङ्गु: हिरङ्गु m. (-ङ्गुः) The personified ascending node.
हिरण: हिरण n. (-णं) 1 Gold. 2 Semen. 3 A cowry. E. हृ to take, ल्युट् aff., and इ substituted for the antepen. vowel: see हिरण्य.
हिरण्मय: हिरण्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of gold, golden. m. (-यः) BRAHMĀ. n. (-यं) One of the Varṣas or divisions of the continent; the part between the mountainous ranges Śveta and Śṛṅgavān. E. हिरण् for हिरण gold, मयट् aff.
हिरण्य: हिरण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 Gold. 2 Either of the precious metals, crude bullion, unwrought gold or silver. 3 Silver, crude or wrought. 4 A measure. 5 A cowry. 6 Semen virile. 7 Imperishable matter, that which is eternal. 8 Thing, substance. 9 Wealth, property. E. हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. कन्यन्, and किरच् substituted for the radical letters.
हिरण्यकशिपु: हिरण्यकशिपु m. (-पुः) A Daitya, the father of PRAHLĀDA, for whose destruction, VIṢṆU descended in the fourth or NARASIṂHA Avatāra. E. हिरण्य gold, and कशिपु clothing, or food and clothing.
हिरण्यकशिपुहन्: हिरण्यकशिपुहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. हिरण्यकशिपु a Daitya, and हन् destroyer.
हिरण्यगर्भ: हिरण्यगर्भ m. (-र्भः) BRAHMĀ. E. हिरण्य gold, गर्भं embryo; or the mundane egg floating on the water at creation, of that metal, or of similar colour, from which the deity issued, according to some legends.
हिरण्यद: हिरण्यद m. (-दः) The ocean. f. (-दा) The earth. E. हिरण्य gold, and द what gives or yields.
हिरण्यनाभ: हिरण्यनाभ m. (-भः) The mountain Maināka. E. हिरण्य gold, नाम navel.
हिरण्यबाहु: हिरण्यबाहु m. (-हुः) 1 The river Śoṇa. 2 ŚIVA. E. हिरण्य golden, बाहु an arm.
हिरण्यरेतस्: हिरण्यरेतस् m. (-ताः) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. 3 ŚIVA. E. हिरण्य gold, and रेतस् semen.
हिरण्यव: हिरण्यव m. (-वः) A divine treasure. E. हिरण्य gold, व possessive aff. in this sense.
हिरण्यवर्णा: हिरण्यवर्णा f. (-र्णा) A river in general. E. हिरण्य gold, and वर्ण colour.
हिरण्यवाह: हिरण्यवाह m. (-हः) The river Śoṇa. E. हिरण्य gold, वह to bear, aff. अण्.
हिरण्याक्ष: हिरण्याक्ष m. (-क्षः) The name of a demon, killed by VIṢṆU. E. हिरण्य, and अक्ष for अक्षि eye.
हिरुक्: हिरुक् ind. 1 Without, except. 2 In the midst of, amongst. 3 Near. E. हि to go, रुकक् aff.
हिल: हिल r. 6th cl. (हिलति) To express amorous inclination, to dally, to wanton, to sport amorously.
हिलमोचि: हिलमोचि f. (-चिः-ची) A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.) E. हिल sporting, मुच्च to loosen, इन् aff., ङीष् optionally added; also with कन् added, fem. form, हिलभोचिका.
हिव: हिव (इ) हिवि r. 1st cl. (हिव्वति) 1 To be satisfied. 2 To satisfy or please.
हिस: हिस (इ) हिसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (हिंसति हिंसयति) and 7th cl. (हिनस्ति) To hurt, to injure, to do any thing tending to the prejudice of another in word, thought, or deed.
हिहि: हिहि ind. An interjection of surprise or merriment.
ही: ही ind. 1 An exclamation or interjection of surprise; 2 Of fatigue or despondence; 3 Of sorrow; 4 A particle implying cause, (therefore, so.) E. हन to hurt, डी aff.
हीन: हीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Deficient, defective. 2 Blamable, vile, bad. 3 Left, abandoned, quitted. 4 Wasted, worn, decayed. 5 Void of, free from. m. (-नः) An insufficient or objectionable witness. E. हा to quit, aff. क्त.
हीनकर्मन्: हीनकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Neglecting, or not performing the customary rites, &c. E. हीन, and कर्म्मन् act; also हीनक्रिय, &c.
हीनकर्म्मन्: हीनकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Neglecting, or not performing the customary rites, &c. E. हीन, and कर्म्मन् act; also हीनक्रिय, &c.
हीनजाति: हीनजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Outcaste, vile, degraded. E. हीन abandoned, and जाति caste.
हीनवर्ण: हीनवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Of a low caste, outcaste, vile. E. हीन, and वर्ण caste.
हीनवाद: हीनवाद m. (-दः) Prevarication, contradictory evidence. E. हीन, and वाद speech.
हीनवादिन्: हीनवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Dumb, speechless. 2 Inadmissible, (as a witness.) 3 Contradictory, prevaricating. E. हीन left, or defective, वाद speech, इनि aff.
हीनसख्य: हीनसख्य n. (-ख्यं) Keeping low company, associating with persons of degraded castes and occupations. E. हीन an outcaste, and सख्य friendship.
हीनसन्धि: हीनसन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) Destitute of peace or reconciliation. E. हीन, and सन्धि alliance.
हीनसेवा: हीनसेवा f. (-वा) Serving or attending on low persons, associating with them. E. हीन, and सेवा service.
हीनाङ्ग: हीनाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Crippled, maimed, defective. f. (-ङ्गी) An ant. E. हीन deficient, and अङ्ग the body.
हीन्ताल: हीन्ताल m. (-लः) The marshy date tree: see हिन्ताल.
हीर: हीर m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 3 A snake. 4 A necklace. 5 A lion. n. (-रं) A diamond. f. (-रा) 1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 2 A cockroach. 3 An ant. E. हृ to take, क aff., and ईरु substituted for the radical finals.
हीरक: हीरक m. (-कः) The diamond. E. कन् added to the last.
हीराङ्ग: हीराङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. हीर the diamond, and अङ्ग substance; being supposed to be the same.
हीलुक: हीलुक n. (-कं) Rum, spirits distilled from molasses.
हीही: हीही ind. 1 An interjection of surprise, (ah, ha!) 2 An interjection of laughter, (hee, hee!) E. ही repeated.
हु: हु r. 3rd cl. (जुहोति) 1 To sacrifice, to offer in oblation. 2 To eat. 3 To take. 4 To please or satisfy. 5 To throw or cast.
हुङ्कार: हुङ्कार m. (-रः) Uttering a menacing sound, roaring, bellowing. E. हुम्, and कार making; also similar compounds, as हुङ्कृति, हुङ्कृत, &c.
हुङ्कृत: हुङ्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered or pronounced as an incantation. n. (-तं) 1 An incantation. 2 The roar or grunt of the wild boar. 3 Any roar. E. हुम् a mystical monosyllable, and कृत made.
हुड: हुड r. 6th cl. (हुडति) To heap together, to collect or accumulate. (ऋ) हुडृ r. 1st cl. (होडति) To go or move. (इ) हुडि r. 1st cl. (हुण्डते) 1 To heap, &c. 2 To accept, to agree to, or assent. 3 To take.
हुडु: हुडु m. (-डुः) A ram. E. हुड to assemble, aff. कु.
हुडुक्क: हुडुक्क m. (-क्कः) 1 A gallinule. 2 A drunken man. 3 A small hourglass-shaped drum. 4 A stick or staff, one bound with iron. 5 The bar of a door. E. हुडुक् imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. क.
हुण्ड: हुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A tiger. 2 A village hog. 3 A blockhead. 4 An imp, a goblin. 5 A ram. E. हुडि to collect, अच् aff.
हुर्च्छ: हुर्च्छ r. 1st cl. (हुर्च्छति) To be crooked, (literally or figuratively,) to be fraudulent. 2 To retreat, to hide or abscond.
हुत: हुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Offered with fire, burnt as an oblation. 2 Called, invoked. n. (-तं) Oblation. E. हु to sacrifice, or ह्वे to call, क्त aff.
हुतभुक्प्रिया: हुतभुक्प्रिया f. (-या) The wife of AGNI or fire. E. हुतभुज् AGNI, and प्रिया the wife.
हुतभुज्: हुतभुज् m. (-भुक्) AGNI or fire. E. हुत an oblation, भुज to eat, क्विप् aff.
हुतवह: हुतवह m. (-हः) AGNI or fire. E. हुत an oblation, and वह who carries.
हुतहोम: हुतहोम m. (-मः) A Brahman who has offered an oblation. n. (-मं) An oblation. E. हुत, and होम sacrifice.
हुताग्नि: हुताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Fire with which oblation is made. E. हुत, and अग्नि fire.
हुताश: हुताश m. (-शः) Fire or its deity AGNI. E. हुत an oblation, and अश who eats.
हुताशन: हुताशन m. (-नः) 1 Fire or its deity. 2 ŚIVA. E. हुत burnt-offering, and अशन food.
हुत्वा: हुत्वा ind. Having offered in oblation. E. हु to offer, क्त्वा aff.
हुम्: हुम् ind. 1 An interjection of remembering, (ha, ah!) 2 Of repulse or reproach, (away!) 3 Interrogation, (hey?) 4 Assent, (yes.) 5 Doubt. 6 A mystical syllable of frequent occurrence in incantations. E. हु to sacrifice, डुम् aff.
हुयमान: हुयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being offered in oblation. E. हु to offer, pass. v., शानच् aff.
हुल: हुल r. 1st cl. (होस्नति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To kill. 3 To cover.
हुस्नहुली: हुस्नहुली f. (-स्नी) Inarticulate sounds made by women, especially a sort of Ululatus, though apparently employed upon pleasurable and not sorrowful occasions.
हुहु: हुहु m. (-हुः) A Gandharba. E. ह्वेञ् to call, डु aff., form irr.
हुहू: हुहू m. (-हूः) A Gandharba or chorister of heaven. E. ह्वेञ् to call, डु aff., form irr.; it is also read हुहु, हूहु, and हूहू.
हू: हू ind. An interjection of calling, of contempt, of pride, and of grief or weeping.
हूङ्कार: हूङ्कार m. (-रः) 1 Uttering the sound Hum. 2 Roaring. E. हूम्, and कार making.
हूड: हूड (ऋ) हूडृ r. 1st cl. (हूडति) To go, to move.
हूण: हूण m. (-णः) A barbarian, a Hun.
हूत: हूत m. (-तः-ता-तं) Called, summoned, invited. E. ह्वे to call, क्त aff.
हूति: हूति f. (-तिः) 1 Calling. 2 Calling to in defiance, challenging. E. ह्वेञ् to call, aff. क्तिच्.
हूम्: हूम् ind. 1 A particle or doubt or consideration (humph, ha.) 2 An interrogatory particle, (hey, indeed.) 3 A particle of assent, (yes, well, so be it, amen.) 4 An interjection, of anger. 5 Of fear. 6 Of reproach, contempt, (equivalent to be silent, tush, pish.) 7 Of aversion, repulse, or dislike, &c. 8 A magical or mystical monosyllable. 9 An imitative sound. E. ह्वेञ् to call, aff. डूम्.
हूयमान: हूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being offered in oblation. E. हु to offer pass. v., शानच् aff.
हूरव: हूरव m. (-वः) A jackal. E. हू a cry of fear or wrath, and रव, sound.
हूर्च्छन: हूर्च्छन n. (-नं) Crookedness, (literal or figurative,) craft, cunning. E. हुर्च्छ to be crooked, ल्युट् aff.
हूहु: हूहु m. (-हुः) A Gandharba: see हुहू.
हूहू: हूहू m. (-हूः) A Gandharba: see हुहू.
हृ: हृ r. 1st cl. (ञ्) हृञ् r. 1st cl. (हरति-ते) 1 To convey. 2 To take or accept. 3 To steal. 4 To destroy or annul. r. 3rd cl. (हजर्त्ति) To take by violence. With अनु prefixed, To imitate. With अप, 1 To remove, to take away or apart. 2 To leave behind. 3 To steal. With अभि, To assault. With अभि and आङ्, To reason. With अभि and उत्, To deliver. With अभि, वि, and आङ्, To utter, to pronounce. With अव, 1 To regain. 2 To punish or fine. With उत्, 1 To raise, to lift or take up. 2 To expel. With उद् and आङ्, 1 To say or tell. 2 To illustrate, to exemplify. With उप, 1 To bring near to. 2 To give. With उप and सम्, To withhold. With नि changed to नी, To freeze. With निर्, To shew disrespect. With निर् and आङ्, To fast. With परि, 1 To reproach, to abuse or censure. 2 To leave, to shun, to abandon. 3 To resist. 4 To extract. With प्र, To strike. With प्रति changed to प्रती, To keep watch. With प्रति and आङ्, To think abstractedly by restraining the organs of sense. With प्रति and सम्, To disregard, to abandon. With वि, To sport, to ramble for pleasure. With वि, or वि and आङ्, To say, to utter, to speak. With वि and अव, 1 To transact business. 2 To litigate. With सम्, To kill. With सम्, or सम् and आङ्, To collect, to assemble. With सम्, अभि, वि and आङ्, To speak in concert. With सम्, उत् and आङ्, To relate. With सम् and उप, 1 To give. 2 To assemble, to collect. With सम् and प्र, To fight. With वि and अति prefixed and implying reciprocity (व्यतिहरते) To steal or plunder mutually. In the first sense (to convey), this verb governs two accusatives, as भारं हरति ग्रामं he takes the load (to) the village.
हृच्छय: हृच्छय m. (-यः) KĀMADEVA. E. हृत् the heart, and शय who sleeps.
हृणिया: हृणिया f. (-या) 1 Shame, modesty. 2 Censure, reproach. E. हृणीङ् Kaṇḍvādi root, to be ashamed, यक् aff., and the vowel made short; otherwise हृणीया.
हृणीया: हृणीया f. (-या) 1 Censure, reproach. 2 Shame, bashfulness. E. see the last.
हृत: हृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken, taken away, seized. 2 Accepted. E. हृ to take, क्त aff.
हृतसर्वस्व: हृतसर्व्वस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Robbed or stripped of all, entirely ruined. E. हृत, and सर्व्वस्व all.
हृतसर्व्वस्व: हृतसर्व्वस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Robbed or stripped of all, entirely ruined. E. हृत, and सर्व्वस्व all.
हृताधिकार: हृताधिकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Neglecting one's duty. 2 Deprived of an office, turned out. 3 Barred or deprived of one's right. E. हृत, and अधिकार superintendence.
हृतोत्तर: हृतोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Left without a reply. E. हृत, and उत्तर answer.
हृत्पिण्ड: हृत्पिण्ड n. (-ण्डं) The heart. E. हृत्, and पिण्ड lump of flesh.
हृत्वा: हृत्वा ind. Having taken, seized, accepted, &c. E. हृ to take, क्त्वा aff.
हृत्स्थ: हृत्स्थ mfn. (-त्स्थः-त्स्था-त्स्थं) Seated in the heart. E. हृत्, and स्थ what stays.
हृद्: हृद् n. (हृत् or हृद्) 1 The heart. 2 The mind, the faculty or seat of thought and feeling. E. हृ to take, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added; or हृद् substituted for the following.
हृदय: हृदय n. (-यं) 1 The mind, the seat or faculty of thought and feeling. 2 The heart. 3 Knowledge. E. हृ to take, कयन् Uṇādi aff., and दुक् augment.
हृदयग्राहिन्: हृदयग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Captivating, engaging the affections. E. हृदय, and ग्राहिन् taking.
हृदयङ्गम: हृदयङ्गम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Apposite and proper, (as speech.) 2 Affecting, touching. 3 Dear, beloved. E. हृदय the heart, गम to go, खश् aff.
हृदयवत्: हृदयवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Good-hearted, kind, humane. E. हृदय the heart, and मतुप् aff.
हृदयस्थान: हृदयस्थान n. (-नं) The breast, the chest. E. हृदय the heart, and स्थान place.
हृदयात्मन्: हृदयात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A heron. E. हृदय the heart, and आत्मन् self.
हृदयालु: हृदयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Good-hearted. E. हृदय the heart, and आलुच् aff.
हृदयाविध्: हृदयाविध् mfn. (-त् or द्) Heart-piercing. E. हृदय, and आविध् what pierces.
हृदयिक: हृदयिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Good-hearted. E. हृदय the heart, and ठन् aff.
हृदयिन्: हृदयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Good-hearted. E. हृदय the heart, and इनि poss. aff.
हृदयेश: हृदयेश m. (-शः) 1 A husband. 2 A wife. E. हृदय the heart, and ईश lord.
हृदयोदङ्क: हृदयोदङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Heart-heaving, distressing. E. हृदय, उत् up, अंक what goes.
हृदावर्त: हृदावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A curl or lock of hair on a horse's neck, or breast. E. हृद् the heart, and आवर्त्त a twist.
हृदावर्त्त: हृदावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A curl or lock of hair on a horse's neck, or breast. E. हृद् the heart, and आवर्त्त a twist.
हृदिस्पृश्: हृदिस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक) Dear, beloved, cherished. E. हृदि in the heart, and स्पृश् what effects.
हृद्गत: हृद्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conceived, come to mind, designed. E. हृद्, and गत gone.
हृद्गोल: हृद्गोल m. (-लः) The name of a mountainous district.
हृद्गोलीय: हृद्गोलीय m. pl. (-याः) The military inhabitants of the Hṛdgola mountains. E. हृद्गोल as above, छ aff.
हृद्देश: हृद्देश m. (-शः) The heart or the region of it. E. हृद्, देश place.
हृद्य: हृद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Dear, beloved, cherished, desired. 2 Grateful, pleasant, agreeable. 3 Produced in or from the heart. 4 Affectionate, kind. m. (-द्यः) A Mantra of the Vedas for effecting any one's subjection or fascination. f. (-द्या) Vṛddhi, a medicinal root, so named. n. (-द्यं) Cassia bark. E. हृद् the heart, यत् aff.
हृद्यगन्ध: हृद्यगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The Bel tree, (Ægle marmelos.) n. (-न्धं) 1 Small cardamoms. 2 Sochal salt. f. (-न्धा) Great-flowered jasmine, E. हृद्य agreeable, and गन्ध smell.
हृद्यता: हृद्यता f. (-ता) Agreeableness, delightfulness. E. हृद्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, हृद्यत्वं.
हृद्रोग: हृद्रोग m. (-गः) 1 Heart-burn. 2 Any disease of the heart. E. हृद् the heart, and रोग disease; also हृदयरोग.
हृद्रोगवैरिन्: हृद्रोगवैरिन् m. (-री) A tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.) E. हृद्रोग the heart-burn, and वैरिन् hostile.
हृद्वण्टक: हृद्वण्टक m. (-कः) The stomach. E. हृद् the heart, and वण्टक a part.
हृल्लास: हृल्लास m. (-सः) Hiccough. E. हृद् the heart, लस् to sport, aff. घञ्.
हृल्लेख: हृल्लेख m. (-खः) Regret, sorrow for any object absent or missing. n. (-खं) Knowledge. E. हृद् the heart, लिख to write, aff. घञ्; also हृदयलेख.
हृष: हृष (इर उ) इरहृषु r. 4th cl. (हृष्यति) To rejoice, to exult, to be pleased or delighted. (उ) हृषु r. 1st cl. (हर्षति) To lie, to affirm falsely.
हृषित: हृषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Astonished, surprised. 2 Pleased, delighted. 3 Exquisitely delighted, having the hair of the body  erect with pleasure. 4 Disappointed, baulked, deceived. 5 Bent, bowed. 6 Armed, accountred. E. हृष to be pleased, aff. क्त, with the augment इट्.
हृषीक: हृषीक n. (-कं) Any organ of sense. E. हृष to affirm falsely, ईकन् Uṇādi aff., and the radical vowel unchanged.
हृषीकेश: हृषीकेश m. (-शः) KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. हृषीक an organ of sense, and ईश lord.
हृष्ट: हृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Pleased, glad, delighted. 2 Laughing, smiling. 3 Having the hair of the body erect with pleasure. 4 Astonished, surprised. 5 Disappointed. E. हृष to be pleased, or to affirm falsely, aff. क्त.
हृष्टपुष्ट: हृष्टपुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Well-conditioned, well fed and happy. E. हृष्ट, and पुष्ट nourished.
हृष्टमानस: हृष्टमानस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Happy, glad. E. हृष्ट pleased, मानस the mind, अण् aff.
हृष्टरोमन्: हृष्टरोमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Having the hair of the body on end. E. हृष्ट delighted, रोमन् the down of the body.
हृष्टहृदय: हृष्टहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Happy, light-hearted. E. हृष्ट, and हृदय the heart.
हृष्टि: हृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Delight, pleasure, happiness. 2 Pride, arrogance. E. हृष to be pleased, aff. क्तिन्.
हे: हे ind. 1 A vocative particle. 2 A particle of calling out to, or challenging. 3 An interjection, expressing envy or malice. E. हि to go, aff. डे.
हेक्का: हेक्का f. (-क्का) Hiccough. E. हिक्क to hiccough, aff. अच्, and the vowel changed.
हेट: हेट r. 1st cl. (हेटते) To resist, to oppose.
हेठ: हेठ r. 1st cl. (हेठते) (ऋ) हेठृ (हेठति) 1 To resist, to oppose, to contend with, to vex or harass. 2 To be wicked.
हेठ m. (-ठः) 1 Obstruction, opposition, hindering, preventing. 2 Injury, hurting. E. हेठ to annoy or oppose, aff. अच्.
हेड: हेड r. 1st cl. (हेडति) To surround, to encompass. (ऋ) हेडृ (हेडते) To disregard, to contemn.
हेढ: हेढ r. 9th cl. (हेढणाति) 1 To be past birth. 2 To produce young. 3 To purify.
हेति: हेति f. (-तिः) 1 A weapon. 2 A ray of the sun. 3 Flame. E. हि to go, or हन to kill, aff. क्तिन्; the form is irr.
हेतु: हेतु m. (-तुः) 1 Cause, origin, motive. 2 The reason or argument for an inference or deduction. E. हि to go, Uṇādi aff. तुन्.
हेतुक: हेतुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Causal, instrumental. 2 Relating or belonging to the cause or motive. m. (-कः) An active cause. an instrument or agent. E. हेतु cause, and कन् added.
हेतुता: हेतुता f. (-ता) Causation, cause, causativeness, the abstract existence of cause or motive. E. हेतु cause, तल aff.; also हेतुत्व n. (-त्वं.)
हेतुमत्: हेतुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having a cause, proceding from one, acknowledging one, &c. E. हेतु, and मतुप् aff.
हेतुवाद: हेतुवाद m. (-दः) Disputation. E. हेतु, and वाद dispute.
हेतौ: हेतौ ind. By reason or cause of. E. हेतु in the seventh case, used as a particle.
हेत्वाभास: हेत्वाभास m. (-सः) (In logic,) Fallacious semblance of reason or argument, assignment of proof or cause which can be shewn to be incorrect; various kinds are specified. E. हेतु, and आभास semblance.
हेम: हेम m. (-मः) A horse of a dark colour. n. (-मं) Gold. f. (-मा) 1 An Apsaras or courtesan of INDRA'S heaven. 2 A handsome woman. E. हि to go, मक् aff.
हेमकन्दस्न: हेमकन्दस्न m. (-लः) Coral. E. हेम gold, and कन्दस्न a shoot.
हेमकार: हेमकार m. (-रः) A goldsmith. E. हेमन् gold, and कार who makes or works; also हेमकर्त्तृ (-र्त्ता,) &c.
हेमकूट: हेमकूट m. (-टः) One of the ranges of mountains dividing the known continent into nine Varṣas; this range is the second south of Ilāvṛta, or the central division, and is immediately to the north of the Himālaya, forming with it the boundaries of the Kinnara Varṣam. E. हेम gold or golden, and कूट a peak.
हेमकेलि: हेमकेलि m. (-लिः) Fire. E. हेम gold, and केलि who sports.
हेमकेश: हेमकेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. हेम gold, and केश् hair.
हेमक्षीरी: हेमक्षीरी f. (-री) A medicinal sort of moon-plant. E. हेम gold, and क्षीरी a name of several plants.
हेमगन्धिनी: हेमगन्धिनी f. (-नी) Reṇuka, a perfume. E. हेम golden, and गन्धिनी a perfume.
हेमज्वास्न: हेमज्वास्न m. (-लः) Fire. E. हेम gold, and ज्वाला flame.
हेमतरु: हेमतरु m. (-रुः) Datura or thorn-apple. E. हेम, and तरु tree.
हेमतार: हेमतार n. (-रं) Blue vitriol. E. हेम gold, तृ to pass, aff. घञ्.
हेमदुग्ध: हेमदुग्ध m. (-ग्धः) The glomerous fig tree. f. (-ग्धी) A medicinal sort of moon-plant. E. हेम gold, टुग्ध milk; also with कन् added, हेमटुग्धक.
हेमदुग्धक: हेमदुग्धक m. (-कः) The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata:) see the last.
हेमन्: हेमन् n. (-म) Gold. m. (-मा) 1 The planet MERCURY. 2 Winter. E. हि to go, मनिन् aff.
हेमन्त: हेमन्त mn. (-न्तः-न्तं) The cold season, winter, the two months, Agrahāyaṇa and Pauṣa, or about November-December. E. हन to hurt, भच् Uṇādi aff., हि substituted for the root, and मुट् augment.
हेमन्तनाथ: हेमन्तनाथ m. (-थः) Elephant or wood-apple. E. हेमन्त winter, and नाथ lord.
हेमपर्वत: हेमपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The mountain Meru. E. हेम gold, and पर्व्वत mountain.
हेमपर्व्वत: हेमपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The mountain Meru. E. हेम gold, and पर्व्वत mountain.
हेमपुष्प: हेमपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 The Aśoka tree, (Jonesia Asoca.) 2 The China rose, the flower. m. (-ष्पः) 1 The Champaka, (Michelia champaca.) 2 The Lodh tree. f. (-ष्पी) Bengal madder. E. हेम golden, and पुष्प a flower.
हेमपुष्पक: हेमपुष्पक m. (-कः) The Champaka. f. (-ष्पिका) Yellow jasmine. E. कन् added to the last.
हेममाला: हेममाला f. (-ला) The wife of YAMA. E. हेम gold, and माला a garland.
हेमरत्नमय: हेमरत्नमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Full of gold and gems. E. हेम, and रत्न a gem, मयट् aff.
हेमरागिणी: हेमरागिणी f. (-णी) Turmeric. E. हेम gold, राग colour, इनि and ङीष् affs.
हेमल: हेमल m. (-लः) 1 A goldsmith. 2 A chameleon, a lizard. 3 A touchstone. E. हेम gold, ला to have or take, aff. क.
हेमवल: हेमवल n. (-लं) A pearl. E. हेम gold, वल surrounding.
हेमशङ्ख: हेमशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) VIṢṆU. E. हेम gold, and शङ्ख a shell.
हेमशिखा: हेमशिखा f. (-खा) A medicinal sort of moon-plant. E. हेम gold, and शिखा crest.
हेमसूत्रक: हेमसूत्रक n. (-कं) A necklace. E. हेम gold, सूत्र a string, कन् added.
हेमाङ्ग: हेमाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 GARUḌA. 2 A lion. 3 The mountain Sumeru. 4 BRAHMĀ. 5 The Champaka, (Michelia champaca.) E. हेम gold, and अङ्ग body.
हेमाद्रि: हेमाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The mountain Meru. E. हेम gold, and अद्रि a mountain.
हेय: हेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be left, abandoned, avoided, &c. E. हा to quit, यत् aff.
हेर: हेर n. (-रं) 1 A sort of crown or tiara. 2 Turmeric. 3 The illusion of a demon. E. हि to go, रक् aff.
हेरम्ब: हेरम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 GAṆEŚA. 2 A buffalo. 3 A hero inflated with his own valour and prowess. 4 A Buddha or Bauddha deity. E. हे calling or defying, रवि to sound, aff. अच्.
हेरम्बजननी: हेरम्बजननी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. हेरम्ब GAṆEŚA, and जननी mother.
हेरम्बहट्ट: हेरम्बहट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A country included in the enumeration of the provinces of the Dekhin. E. हेरम्ब GAṆEŚA, and हट्ट fair.
हेरिक: हेरिक m. (-कः) A spy, a secret emissary or agent.
हेरुक: हेरुक m. (-कः) 1 An attendant on Mahākāla, or ŚIVA in that form. 2 An inferior divinity of the Bauddhas.
हेलन: हेलन n. (-नं) 1 Disrespect, disregard, contempt. 2 Wantoning, dalliance. E. हिस्न to disregard, aff. ल्युट्.
हेला: हेला f. (-ला) 1 Wanton dalliance, lascivious endearment. 2 Disrespect, contempt. 3 Moonlight. E. हिल to dally, aff. अच् and टाप्.
हेलि: हेलि m. (-लिः) The sun. f. (-लिः) Dalliance, wanton sport. E. हिस्न to dally, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
हेष: हेष (ऋ) हेषृ r. 1st cl. (हेषते) To neigh as a horse.
हेषा: हेषा f. (-षा) Neighing, (as a horse, or braying, as an ass.) E. हेष to sound, to neigh, aff. अच् and ठाप्.
हेषिन्: हेषिन् m. (-षी) A horse. E. हेषा neighing, and इनि aff.
हेहे: हेहे ind. 1 A particle of addressing, a vocative particle. 2 An interjection of calling aloud. E. हे the same, repeated.
है: है ind. 1 A vocative particle. 2 An interjection of calling. E. ह्वे to call, डै aff.
हैतुक: हैतुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Causal, causative. m. (-कः) 1 A follower of the Mīmāṃsā doctrines. 2 A sceptic, a causalist. E. हेतु cause, ठक् aff.
हैम: हैम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Golden. 2 Frigid, freezing, cold. n. (-मं) Hoar-frost. f. (-मी) Yellow jasmine. E. हेमन् gold, or हिम frost, अण् aff.
हैमन: हैमन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Cold, wintry. 2 Growing in winter. 2 Suitable to winter. m. (-नः) The month Mārgaśīrṣa. n. (-नं) The winter season. E. हेमन्त winter, अण् aff., and the final optionally rejected.
हैमन्त: हैमन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) 1 Wintry, cold. 2 Growing in winter, &c. 3 Suitable to the winter, (as abode or clothing, &c.) n. (-न्तं) The winter season. E. हेमन्त winter, अण् aff.
हैमन्तिक: हैमन्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Wintry, freezing, frigid. E. हेमन्त, and ठक् aff.
हैमल: हैमल mn. (-लः-लं) Winter. E. हिमल cold, अण् aff.
हैमवत: हैमवत n. (-तं) Bharata Varṣa or India. m. (-तः) A sort of poison. f. (-ती) 1 PĀRVATĪ. 2 Chebulic myrobalan. 3 A medicinal kind of moon-plant. 4 A white kind of Orris root. 5 The Ganges. E. हिसवत् the snowy mountains skirting India, अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्.
हैयङ्गवीन: हैयङ्गवीन n. (-नं) 1 Clarified butter prepared a day before it is used. 2 Fresh butter. E. ह्य yesterday, गोदोह milk, हियङ्ग substituted for them, and खञ् aff.
हैहेय: हैहेय m. (-यः) A prince; also KĀRTAVĪRYA.
हो: हो ind. 1 A vocative particle. 2 An interjection of calling out to, or challenging. E. ह्वेञ् to call, डो aff.
होड: होड (ऋ) होडृ r. 1st cl. (होडति) To go, to move. (होडते) To disregard, to disrespect.
होड m. (-डः) A raft, a float, a boat. E. हाड to go, aff. अच्.
होडृ: होडृ m. (-डा) A robber, a footpad or highway robber. E. हुड to collect, तृच् aff.
होढ: होढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Stolen. n. (-ढं) Stolen goods. E. हुड to steal, क्त aff.
होतृ: होतृ m. (-ता) A priest, who at a sacrifice recites the prayers of the Rig Veda; one conversant with that Veda. E. हु to sacrifice, Uṇādi aff. तृच्.
होत्र: होत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 An article intended or fit for offering with fire, generally clarified butter. 2 Burnt-offering, oblation with fire. E. हु to sacrifice, ष्ट्रन् aff.
होत्रीय: होत्रीय n. (-यं) A place where oblations are offered. m. (-यः) A priest offering an oblation. E. होत्र an offering, छ aff.
