होम: होम m. (-मः) Burnt-offering, the casting of clarified butter, &c. into the sacred fire, as an offering to the gods, accompanied with prayers or invocations, according to the object of the sacrifice. E. हु to sacrifice, मन् Uṇādi aff.
होमकुण्ड: होमकुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A hole in the ground or an altar, for receiving the fire for an oblation. E. होम burnt-offering, and कुण्ड a hole.
होमधूम: होमधूम m. (-मः) The smoke of burnt-offering. E. होम as above, and धूम smoke.
होमभस्मन्: होमभस्मन् n. (-स्म) The ashes of a burnt-offering. E. होम as above, भस्मन् ashes.
होमवत्: होमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having performed sacrifice. E. होम, and मतुप् aff.
होमाग्नि: होमाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Sacrificial fire. E. होम an oblation, and अग्नि fire.
होमि: होमि m. (-मिः) 1 Clarified butter. 2 Fire. 3 Water. E. हु to sacrifice, मिन् aff.
होमिन्: होमिन् m. (-मी) The offerer of an oblation. E. हु to sacrifice, मिनि Uṇādi aff.
होरा: होरा f. (-रा) 1 The rising of a sign of the zodiac. 2 Part of the duration of a sign, the twenty-fourth part of a day, an hour. 3 A mark, a line. 4 A science or work in science, probably on astrology. E. होड to go, to proceed, affs. अच and टाप, and ड changed to र.
होलाका: होलाका f. (-का) The ceremony of throwing a red powder called Holi.
होहौ: होहौ ind. 1 An interjection of calling. 2 An exclamation of challenging or defiance. E. हो, and हौ both the same.
हौ: हौ ind. 1 An interjection of defiance or challenge. 2 A vocative particle. E. ह्वेञ् to call, डौ aff.
हौतृक: हौतृक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or appertaining to the Hotṛ or priest so named. E. हौतृ a priest, and ठञ् aff.
हौम्य: हौम्य n. (-म्यं) Clarified butter. E. होम burnt-offering, यञ् aff.
हौम्यधान्य: हौम्यधान्य n. (-न्यं) Sesamum. E. हौम्य relating to burnt-offering, and धान्य grain.
ह्नु: ह्नु r. 2nd cl. (ह्नुते) To take away, to withhold or secrete. With अप or नि prefixed, To conceal, to hide, to deny.
ह्मल: ह्मल r. 1st cl. (ह्मलति) To move, to shake.
ह्यस्: ह्यस् ind. Yesterday. E. अहन् a day, deriv. irr.
ह्यस्तन: ह्यस्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Of yesterday, produced or occurred yesterday. E. ह्यस् yesterday, द्यु aff.
ह्यस्त्य: ह्यस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of yesterday: see the last. E. ह्यस् yesterday, and त्यप् aff.
ह्रग: ह्रग (ए) ह्रगे r. 1st cl. (ह्रगति) To cover.
ह्रणिया: ह्रणिया f. (-या) 1 Censure, reproach. 2 Shame. E. हृणीङ् Kaṇḍvādi root, to feel shame, यक् aff., form irr.: see ह्रिणीया.
ह्रद: ह्रद m. (-दः) 1 A deep lake, a large or deep piece of water. 2 A ray of light. E. ह्राद to sound, aff. अच्, and the deriv. irr.
ह्रदग्रह: ह्रदग्रह m. (-हः) An alligator, a crocodile. E. ह्रद a lake, and ग्रह abode.
ह्रदिनी: ह्रदिनी f. (-नी) 1 A river in general. 2 Lightning. E. ह्रद deep water, इनि and ङीप् affs.
ह्रस: ह्रस r. 1st cl. (ह्रसति) 1 To sound. 2 To be small or few.
ह्रसित: ह्रसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made little, diminished. 2 Sounded. E. ह्रस to sound, क्त aff.
ह्रसिष्ठ: ह्रसिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very short or small. E. ह्रस्व short, aff. of the irr. superlative इष्ठन्, form irr.; also with इयसुन् aff. ह्रसीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः.)
ह्रसिमन्: ह्रसिमन् m. (-मा) Smallness, shortness. E. ह्रस्व short, small, इमनिच् aff., form irr.
ह्रस्व: ह्रस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) 1 Short, low in stature. 2 Short, as a vowel. m. (-स्वः) A dwarf. E. ह्रस to be small, and व aff.
ह्रस्वगवेधुका: ह्रस्वगवेधुका f. (-का) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. ह्रस्व short, गवेधुका coix.
ह्रस्वदर्भ: ह्रस्वदर्भ m. (-र्भः) A short kind of Kuśa grass. E. ह्रस्व short, दर्भ the same.
ह्रस्वपत्रक: ह्रस्वपत्रक m. (-कः) A sort of Bassia. E. ह्रस्व short, पत्र a leaf, and कन् added.
ह्रस्वाग्नि: ह्रस्वाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The gigantic Asclepias, (A. gigantea.)
ह्रस्वाङ्ग: ह्रस्वाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A medicinal root, commonly Jīvaka. 2 A dwarf. E. ह्रस्व short, and अङ्ग the body.
ह्राद: ह्राद r. 1st cl. (-ह्रादते) To sound, inarticulately.
ह्राद m. (-दः) Noise, sound. E. ह्राद to sound, aff. अच्.
ह्रादिन्: ह्रादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Sounding, making a sound or noise. f. (-नी) 1 Lightning. 2 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 3 A river in general. 4 The Olibanum tree. E. ह्राद to sound, affs. इनि and ङीप्.
ह्रास: ह्रास m. (-सः) Sound, noise. E. ह्रस to sound, aff. घञ्.
ह्रिणीया: ह्रिणीया f. (-या) 1 Censure, abuse. 2 Shame. E. हृणीङ् to be ashamed, aff. यक्, and the vowel changed to रि; also हृणीया, &c.
ह्रित: ह्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ashamed, modest, bashful. 2 Divided, portioned. 3 Taken, conveyed. n. (-तं) A portion, a share. E. ह्री to be ashamed, क्त aff., and the vowel made short; or हृ to take, aff. क्त, and रि substituted for ऋ.
ह्रिति: ह्रिति f. (-तिः) Taking, conveying. E. रि substituted for ऋ: see हृति.
ह्रियमाण: ह्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Being taken or seized. 2 Being captivated, attracted, &c. E. हृ to take, pass. v., शाभच् aff.
ह्रिवेर: ह्रिवेर n. (-रं) A perfume. E. see ह्रीवेर.
ह्री: ह्री r. 3rd cl. (जिह्रेति) To be modest or ashamed.
ह्री f. (-ह्रीः) Shame, bashfulness. E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्विप्.
ह्रीका: ह्रीका f. (-का) 1 Modesty, shame. 2 Fear, terror. E. ह्री to be ashamed, Uṇādi aff. कन्; also र changed to ल, ह्लीका.
ह्रीकु: ह्रीकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) Ashamed, modest. m. (-कुः) 1 Lac. 2 Tin. E. ह्री to be ashamed, Uṇādi aff. कुक्; also ह्लीकु.
ह्रीच्छ: ह्रीच्छ r. 1st cl. (ह्रीच्छति) To be modest or ashamed.
ह्रीजित: ह्रीजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest, ashamed. E. ह्री shame, and जित overcome.
ह्रीण: ह्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Ashamed. E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्तु, form irr.
ह्रीत: ह्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, bashful, modest. E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्त, form reg.: see the last.
ह्रीनिरास: ह्रीनिरास m. (-सः) Shamelessness. E. ह्री, and निरास throwing aff.
ह्रीमत्: ह्रीमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Bashful, modest, ashamed. E. ह्री, and मतुप् aff.
ह्रीवेर: ह्रीवेर n. (-रं) A drug and perfume, commonly Bāla. E. ह्री shame, and वेर saffron.
ह्रीवेल: ह्रीवेल n. (-लं) A perfume: see the last. E. ह्रीवेर as before, र changed to ल; also with कन् added, ह्रीवेलकं.
ह्रेपण: ह्रेपण n. (-णं) Putting to shame, excelling, surpassing. E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
ह्रेपयत्: ह्रेपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Putting to shame, outvieing, surpassing. E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., शतृ aff.
ह्रेपित: ह्रेपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made ashamed, put to shame. 2 Excelled, surpassed. E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., क्त aff.
ह्रुड: ह्रुड (ऋ) ह्रुडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रुडति) To collect.
ह्रूड: ह्रूड (ऋ) ह्रूडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रूडति) 1 To collect. 2 To go.
ह्रेष: ह्रेष (ऋ) ह्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रेषते) 1 To sound inarticulaly, to neigh as a horse. 2 To go, to move.
ह्रेषा: ह्रेषा f. (-षा) Neighing as a horse. E. ह्रेष to neigh, affs. अ and टाप्.
ह्रोड: ह्रोड (ऋ) ह्रोडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रोडति) To go, to move.
ह्लप: ह्लप r. 10th cl. (ह्लापयति) To speak, to speak articulately: also ह्रप.
ह्लाद: ह्लाद (ई) ह्लादी r. 1st cl. (ह्लादते) 1 To gladden, to delight. 2 To be glad or delighted. 3 To sound, especially as a musical instrument.
ह्लाद m. (-दः) Pleasure, joy. E. ह्लाद to be glad, aff. अच्.
ह्लादन: ह्लादन n. (-नं) Joy, delight. E. ह्लाद to be glad, and ल्युट् aff.
ह्लादित: ह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, happy. E. ह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.
ह्लादिन्: ह्लादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Happy, glad. f. (-नी) The Olibanum tree. E. ह्लाद pleasure, इनि and ङीष् affs.
ह्लीका: ह्लीका f. (-का) Shame, modesty. E. ह्नी to be ashamed, कन् Uṇādi aff., and र changed to ल.
ह्लीकु: ह्लीकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) Ashamed, modest. m. (-कुः) 1 Lac. 2 Tin. E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. कुक्, and र changed to ल.
ह्लेषा: ह्लेषा f. (-षा) Neighing, as a horse or ass, &c. E. ह्लेष for ह्रेष to neigh, aff. अ and टाप्.
ह्वल: ह्वल r. 1st cl. (ह्वलति) To move, to shake.
ह्वृ: ह्वृ r. 1st cl. (ह्वरति) To bend, to curve, to make crooked.
ह्वे: ह्वे r. 1st cl. (ह्वयति) 1 To emulate, to vie with, to wish to overcome or surpass. 2 To struggle or contend with. 3 To call. 4 To challenge. With उप, नि, वि or सम् the verb is deponent (उपह्नयते); also with आङ् if rivalry be signified, (आह्वयते) he challenges.
